aoxiangtianji.description: 一个脱胎于经典《西游记》题材 MUD 的中文武侠/仙侠 MUD，登录横幅另称"翱翔天际之擎日挽月"。
aoxiangtianji.english_description: A Chinese wuxia/xianxia MUD descended from a classic Journey to the West codebase; its login banner styles it "Soaring Through the Heavens: Grasping the Sun and Drawing the Moon." Players start at the South City Inn, develop five innate attributes, and choose one of four temperaments, then progress through storyline chapters echoing Journey to the West ("Havoc in Heaven," "The Journey for Scriptures") alongside a full sect and alliance system built for long-term character growth.
aoxiangtianji.name: 翱翔天际

bixiecanyang.description: 属于"夕阳再现"引擎家族（与 xyzxfk、xyzxfy2、wmkj、jhfy 同宗，核心工具文件字节级相同），作者自述基于"夕阳再现－江湖风云 2－风云再起"开发而成。这一支和另一轮处理过的`xyzx`（夕阳再现）/`jhfy3`（江湖风云3）/`xajh4gkb`（笑傲江湖4公开版）/`xyzxyl201412`（夕阳再现-炎龙20141231）是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同）——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、但地图其实是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3`/`tianxiawuxue`/`yxcs`），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
bixiecanyang.english_description: Part of the "Sunset Reborn" engine family shared with several sibling archives in this project, built, per the author, atop "Sunset Reborn – Jianghu Storm 2 – Storm Resurgent." New characters are placed at random into one of several starting towns across a jianghu spanning Jiaxing, Yangzhou, and other locales, with gender-specific scene descriptions and a full underworld resurrection subsystem shared with sibling games in the same engine family.
bixiecanyang.english_name: Jade Blood, Fading Sun: Ballad of the Twilight Knight
bixiecanyang.name: 碧血残阳 之「豪侠晚歌」

bmxkx2001.description: 属于 ES II/"侠客行"引擎家族（与 xkx2001、xuanjianlu 等同宗，`chinese.c`/`master.c` 字节级相同），1996-1999 年 XiaKeXing Gaming Group 制作、于北美地区运营的一个版本。`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景文件头带着"Cracked by Roath"署名，和另一轮处理过的 `jym`（金庸梦）、`xkm`（侠客梦）是同一批"Cracked by Roath"流通版本（`xkx2000zxb` 则是"Cracked byKafei"的另一份流通版本），此前没有互相记录过这层关系。
bmxkx2001.english_description: Based on Jin Yong's wuxia novel of the same name and centered on Xiake Island, where new players are greeted by one of the island's two envoys and led through registration before entering the wider jianghu. Part of the ES II / "Xiake Xing" engine family, this is a North American release circulated by the XiaKeXing Gaming Group in the late 1990s, with a faithful sect and martial-arts system and an unusually detailed death-and-resurrection sequence.
bmxkx2001.english_name: The Quest of Oriental Chivalry (North American 2001 Edition)
bmxkx2001.name: 侠客行 (The Quest of Oriental Chivalry) — 北美 2001 版

bxsj.description: 重庆电信 ShuJian MUD Wizard Group 自 1997 年起开发维护的经典武侠 MUD，与 bxsj1《书剑·经典》同源，共享大部分核心引擎代码。
bxsj.english_description: A classic wuxia MUD developed and maintained since 1997 by the ShuJian MUD Wizard Group at Chongqing Telecom. New players train in a full beginner region at the martial hall, complete with a training dummy that mirrors an attacker's own stats for safe sparring, and can join any of fifteen sects either through formal apprenticeship or a built-in "gift envoy" shortcut for newcomers.
bxsj.name: 书剑天下 (ShuJian MUD)

bxsj1.description: 与 bxsj《书剑天下》同一底层引擎代码，是"书剑"系列更完整、更晚近的一个存档快照（随包附带多平台生产驱动二进制文件，可见曾真实运营过）。
bxsj1.english_description: A later, more complete snapshot from the same core engine as Book and Sword World (bxsj), inheriting its sect, apprenticeship, and beginner-friendly training systems; ships with multi-platform production driver binaries indicating it once ran as a live server. New characters are personally guided through the basics by an escort NPC at the martial hall.
bxsj1.name: 书剑·经典 (ShuJian Classic)

cctx.description: 一个 ES2/XKX 血统的传统中文 MUD，含嘉峪关（西北边塞）相关地图区域。`niaoren`（鳥人世界）是从同一套源码分支出来、重新包装成金庸题材的独立版本——两者注册流程的天赋选择提示文字逐字相同，`niaoren` 的`logind.lpc` 里还留着一行读取 `/adm/etc/cctxinfo` 的残留代码，是这批档案里"标题和实际代码血统对不上"的又一个例子，详见`niaoren/README.md`。
cctx.english_description: A traditional ES2/XKX-lineage wuxia MUD featuring the familiar sects (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, Beggars' Sect, Emei, Ming Cult) alongside a distinctive northwestern frontier region around Jiayuguan, complete with desert scenes, a city gate, and a pawnshop — an unusually large excursion into frontier themes for this family of games. Newcomers are actively guided by an NPC greeter just outside the welcome room who offers basic survival commands and travel funds.
cctx.name: 驰骋天下

chidi.description: 一款体量庞大的经典武侠 MUD，传统 MudOS 谱系，与"书剑"系列（bxsj/bxsj1）代码源流不同。
chidi.english_description: A large, traditional MudOS-lineage wuxia MUD, unrelated in code lineage to the "Book and Sword" series. New characters choose one of four starting temperaments in the "Land of Peach Blossoms" starting area and can receive a substantial one-time gift of skills and equipment simply by asking a wandering envoy about the jianghu — a much faster on-ramp than formal apprenticeship. Combat is structurally safe (sparring automatically stops around half health), and disconnected players are preserved in place rather than swept into a holding room.
chidi.name: 江湖 I (Jianghu I)

dfgs2.description: 属于"东方故事"/ES 系列引擎（与 es1_win、esI 同属一支，但内容与代码规模都独立、较小巧），早期（1995-1996 年建立）的经典 MUD。
dfgs2.english_description: Part of the "Eastern Story" engine family shared with es1_win and esI in this project, but with independent, smaller-scale content — an early MUD established in 1995-1996. Offers four playable races (Human, Jiaojao, Woochan, Yenhold) drawing more on Western fantasy than wuxia sect traditions, with new characters beginning at a small inn greeted by an innkeeper and waiter in a leaner, old-school style typical of this engine family.
dfgs2.english_name: Eastern Story II: The Celestial Empire
dfgs2.name: 东方故事Ⅱ之天朝帝国 (Eastern Story II: The Celestial Empire)

dfgsiiv13b.description: 一個 1994-2000 年間由 Annihilator 開發的台灣 ES2 血統 MUD（正體中文），登入橫幅另稱「天朝帝國 / Celestial Empire」。
dfgsiiv13b.english_description: An early build (1994-2000) of the ES II engine created by Taiwanese developer Annihilator, in Traditional Chinese, whose login banner also styles itself "Celestial Empire." Its only map content is a single snow village — plaza, inn, blacksmith, market, ruins — closer to the engine's own bundled demo village than a fully realized sect-and-jianghu game, making it the likely origin point for the "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator" lineage seen in later archives in this project.
dfgsiiv13b.name: 東方故事II v1.3b

dtsl.description: 属于"大唐双龙"世界观的一支，与 dtsl2、dtslmud 共享部分基础引擎代码，但各自剧情内容独立开发。取材自黄易同名武侠小说，以大唐初年江湖为背景。
dtsl.english_description: Based on Huang Yi's wuxia novel of the same name and set in the turbulent jianghu of the early Tang dynasty. One of three independently developed games in this project (alongside dtsl2 and dtslmud) that share part of a base engine while each builds its own storyline. New characters begin at the Great Tang Academy, where a guided curriculum introduces the basics before players head down the mountain into the wider world.
dtsl.english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty
dtsl.name: 大唐双龙传 (Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty)

dtsl2.description: 与 dtsl（大唐双龙传）、dtslmud 同属"大唐双龙"世界观分支，但代码实现各自独立（共享部分基础道具内容与中文姓名校验逻辑）。取材自黄易的武侠小说，以大唐初年天下大乱的江湖为背景。
dtsl2.english_description: Another independent implementation in this project's "Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty" family (alongside dtsl and dtslmud), based on Huang Yi's novel and set amid the chaos of the early Tang jianghu. Shares some base items and Chinese-name validation logic with its siblings but is built on its own codebase; new characters start at the Great Tang Academy and the Stone Dragon Martial Hall, a beginner hub offering banking, apprenticeship, and NPC sparring.
dtsl2.english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty (DaTangShuangLong)
dtsl2.name: 大唐双龙 (DaTangShuangLong)

dtslmud.description: LLMUD v0.11 版，改编自黄易同名武侠小说《大唐双龙传》。与本项目中的"dtsl"（大唐双龙传）为同一血脉的姊妹版本，共享同一套底层架构。
dtslmud.english_description: LLMUD v0.11, adapted from Huang Yi's novel "Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty" and a sister build sharing the same underlying architecture as dtsl. Set at the fall of the Sui dynasty and the rise of Tang, players start at the Great Tang Academy and grow through four core attributes assigned at registration, joining sects and factions amid a jianghu of rival warlords; wizards and admins carry the in-game title "Heavenly Emperor."
dtslmud.english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty (LLMUD)
dtslmud.name: 大唐双龙传（LLMUD）

dtxywzxzb.description: 一个西游记血统的 MUD（大唐西游 / Journey of the East），共享`convertd.lpc`/`feature/encoding.lpc` 这套典型 ES II 家族的 GB/BIG5编码切换机制。和 `xyj2006n`（西游记2006年，AKAI Studio 的 Tomud 品牌版）地图逐字节相同（`d/gao/gate.lpc` 等场景内容完全一致），核心系统档案是同一套的两个不同发行版本，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。
dtxywzxzb.english_description: A Journey to the West-lineage MUD sharing the classic ES II GB/BIG5 encoding-switch mechanism with several sibling archives in this project. Set in the mythological world of Journey to the West — the Thirty-Three Heavens, the Peach Garden, Penglai, the Heavenly Palace — it uniquely asks new players at registration whether they are a primary or secondary school student, and separates ordinary login passwords from a stricter admin password reserved for sensitive account operations.
dtxywzxzb.english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (Complete Revised Edition)
dtxywzxzb.name: 大唐西游完整修正版

es1_win.description: "东方故事"（ES）系列 MUD 的一个早期基础版本，属于 **ES / TMI 引擎家族**——尽管名字听起来像武侠题材，实际内容是一个西式奇幻/DND 风格的冒险世界。与本批次的 `esI`（屠龙之战）同源，共享同一套核心引擎代码。
es1_win.english_description: An early foundational build of the "Eastern Story" series and part of the ES/TMI engine family — despite the wuxia-sounding name, it's actually a Western-style fantasy world in the D&D tradition. Shares its core engine with esI (this project's "Dragon Slaying War" build). Offers over a dozen playable races (humans, elves, dwarves, orcs, goblins, halflings, lizardfolk, and more) and a guild-based, rather than sect-based, system of knightly orders, mage towers, priesthoods, monasteries, and thieves' guilds.
es1_win.name: 东方故事（蓝天） — es1_win

esI.description: **东方故事**，站内活动主题为"屠龙之战"（Dragon Slaying War）。与本批次的 `es1_win`（东方故事·蓝天版）同属 **ES / TMI 引擎家族**，两者核心代码几乎一致，仅站点内容与分支细节不同。
esI.english_description: Another build of "Eastern Story," themed around an in-game event called the Dragon Slaying War. Shares nearly identical core code with es1_win (Eastern Story: Blue Sky) from this same engine family, differing mainly in site content and branch details. This particular snapshot ships with a test-era configuration that grants new characters automatic wizard privileges, suggesting it was originally used for internal testing or load trials rather than public play.
esI.name: 东方故事 — esI（"屠龙之战"）

fengyun434.description: **风云四**（风云Ⅳ，Sumxin 风云工作室出品）。属于本批次的**"风云"（Fengyun）武侠引擎家族**，与 `fy2`、`fy2005`、`fy2qh`、`fy3xd`、`fy3dz` 等同属一个核心引擎，各自是不同站点/年代的内容分支。
fengyun434.english_description: Produced by Sumxin's Fengyun studio, part of this project's "Fengyun" wuxia engine family shared with fy2, fy2005, fy2qh, fy3xd, and fy3dz — each a separate content branch from a different site or era built on the same core engine. Set in a jianghu drawn from Gu Long's wuxia novels, players begin as an ordinary commoner just entering the martial world, choosing an ethnicity (Han, Miao, Manchu, or Mongol) that shapes starting attributes and birthplace.
fengyun434.name: 风云Ⅳ — fengyun434

ffxymud.description: 一个"时空游侠录"（Roaming Swordsman）血统的 MUD，登入横幅另称"非凡公子·新月传奇录II"。虽然登入横幅和标题都不一样，但地图和"世界之巅"跳崖场景（`d/city/sj.lpc`）和 `tybxjh`/`xhcii`/`zxty`/`jhfy2`/`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh` 内容逐字节一致，应属同一个"天涯"家族（`wlhd` 也是这个家族，但同一个房间的具体写法已被独立改写过），此前没有任何一份档案互相记录过这层关系。
ffxymud.english_description: Part of the "Roaming Swordsman" engine lineage, though its own login banner instead reads "Extraordinary Young Master: Legend of the New Moon II." Despite the differing names, its map and key scenes are byte-identical to several sibling archives in this project, confirming it belongs to a shared family built on Jin Yong's sect and map world (Huashan, Wudang, Emei, Beggars' Sect, Ming Cult, Tianlong Temple, and more). Uniquely requires clients to send an exact version-handshake string before login proceeds, and needed no mudlib code changes at all to run under WASM.
ffxymud.name: 非凡夕阳MUD

fqyy2.description: 同一套"海洋/hy"代码线家族（`SECURITY_D` 同样指向`adm/daemons/securd.lpc`，和 `hy2000`/`hy2002`/`hy3`/`hy5` 等档案共享这套硬编码后门管理员机制），从一个 rar 套 rar 的嵌套压缩包中提取（内层 `风起云涌.rar` 目录名为 `xkx2`）。
fqyy2.english_description: Part of the same "Ocean" codebase lineage as several sibling archives in this project, sharing their distinctive hardcoded backdoor admin mechanism. Features a larger-than-usual map including the classic sects alongside an independent Assassins' Tower faction and a marriage system, blending social and underworld gameplay. Its admin roster is stored not in a plain text file but inside the security daemon's own save data.
fqyy2.name: 风起云涌2

fy2.description: 河海大学计算机及信息工程学院开发。属于本批次的**"风云"（Fengyun）武侠引擎家族**，与 `fy2005`、`fengyun434`、`fy2qh`、`fy3xd`、`fy3dz` 同源——其中 `fy2qh`（"清华仿写版"）经核实其实就是本档案的另一个转发副本，源码完全一致。
fy2.english_description: Developed by the Computer and Information Engineering College of Hohai University, part of this project's "Fengyun" wuxia engine family alongside fy2005, fengyun434, fy3xd, and fy3dz. Set in a jianghu drawn from Gu Long's wuxia novels, new players choose an ethnicity and start out at the Fengqiuhuang Inn or Chenxiang Town as a novice adventurer; the nearby "Money Gang" offers newcomers an easy first apprenticeship, and two long-running message boards preserve years of player-written poems and reflections.
fy2.name: 风云再起Ⅱ — fy2

fy2005.description: 配置内自报名为"风云Ⅳ"，站内横幅写作"国内经典版"。与 `fengyun434` 是同一套"风云Ⅳ"引擎的不同年份/站点快照，同属本批次的**"风云"（Fengyun）武侠引擎家族**。
fy2005.english_description: The same "Fengyun IV" engine as fengyun434, captured as a different year/site snapshot, with identical Gu Long-inspired wuxia gameplay of choosing an ethnic background and making one's way through jianghu sects. Notable for an ASCII-art CAPTCHA at registration — an unusually early anti-bot measure for this engine family — and for only persisting characters who reach at least 40% experience toward level 2.
fy2005.name: 风云Ⅳ（2005 国内经典版）— fy2005

fy2mg.description: 以古龙小说世界观为背景的武侠 MUD（`jinyongqunxiazhuan`/XKX 框架家族成员，与 jyqxc/jyqxc2/jyqxc2013fwq/xkx2017 共享同一份`adm/obj/master.lpc`，但游戏内容不同，故单独编号）。
fy2mg.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels. It belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family and shares the same adm/obj/master.lpc with sibling games jyqxc, jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, and xkx2017 — but its game content is entirely different, so it is catalogued here under its own number.
fy2mg.name: 风云II（美国版本）

fy2qh.description: 经逐文件核实，本档案与本批次的 `fy2` **实际上是同一份源码的另一个流传副本**（只是打包驱动、玩家存档快照不同），"清华仿写版"更像是当年某个下载站/镜像站给这份拷贝起的名字，而非独立重写的版本。内容与 `fy2`完全一致（详见该库介绍）：以古龙武侠为背景，"金钱帮"新手门派、风云广场留言版与探花诗台、完整表情系统等均可体验。
fy2qh.english_description: File-by-file comparison confirms this archive is actually another surviving copy of the same source code as the sibling game fy2 (differing only in bundled driver and player-save snapshot) — the “Tsinghua remake” label looks like a name a download or mirror site gave this particular copy at the time, rather than an independent rewrite. The content is identical to fy2: a Gu Long-style wuxia world where players can join the beginner-friendly Money Gang, browse the Fengyun Square message board and the Poetry Terrace, and use a full set of emotes.
fy2qh.name: 风云再起Ⅱ（清华仿写版）— fy2qh

fy330.description: 与 151/fy2mg 同为 `jinyongqunxiazhuan`/XKX 框架家族成员（登录流程、`check_legal_name`、密码复杂度要求、民族选择等均字节级相同），但游戏内容和标题不同，与本合集里其它"风云"系 lib（fy2/fys/fysjmb/jhfy2/jhfy3/fyzfqyy/fy2qh/fy3dz/fy3xd/jhfy/zzfy/zzfy3/fengyun434/fy2005）也无 master-hash 匹配。
fy330.english_description: Like fy2mg, this belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family — the login flow, check_legal_name, password complexity rules, and ethnicity selection are byte-for-byte identical — but its game content and title are different, and its master file hash does not match any of the other “Storm”-branded games in this collection (fy2, fys, fysjmb, jhfy2, jhfy3, fyzfqyy, fy2qh, fy3dz, fy3xd, jhfy, zzfy, zzfy3, fengyun434, fy2005).
fy330.name: 风云III (3.0)

fy3dz.description: **风云 3.8.0**，"风云工作室"内部整理的一份"收藏版"合集，在"风云3.7.4"基础上补充了此前未发布/散佚的原创内容。属于本批次的**"风云3"（Fengyun III）引擎分支**，核心引擎代码与 `fy3xd`（星星修订版）几乎完全一致，是这条分支里内容最完整的打包版本之一。
fy3dz.english_description: Storm 3.8.0, a “collector's edition” compiled internally by the “Storm Studio” team, building on Storm 3.7.4 with previously unreleased or otherwise lost original content. It belongs to this batch's Fengyun III (Storm III) engine branch — its core engine code is nearly identical to fy3xd (the “Xingxing revision”) — and is one of the most content-complete packages in that branch.
fy3dz.name: 风云典藏版 — fy3dz

fy3xd.description: 压缩包内附带的说明文档称之为"星星修订的风云3"（社区爱好者"星星"整理修订的一个内容较丰富的版本）。属于本批次的**"风云3"（Fengyun III）引擎分支**，与 `fy3dz`（风云典藏版）核心代码高度一致，属于同一引擎的不同内容打包。
fy3xd.english_description: The readme bundled with the original archive calls this “Storm III, revised by Xingxing” — a content-rich version compiled and revised by a community enthusiast going by “Xingxing.” It belongs to this batch's Fengyun III (Storm III) engine branch, sharing highly similar core code with fy3dz (the “Storm Collector's Edition”) — a different content package built on the same engine.
fy3xd.name: 风云三（星星修订版）— fy3xd

fys.description: 档案名叫"风云三"，但实际登入横幅是"铁血江湖"——内容与档案名无关，只是命名不一致。
fys.english_description: The archive is named “Storm III,” but the actual login banner reads “Jianghu of Blood and Iron” — the content has nothing to do with the archive's filename; it's simply a naming mismatch.
fys.name: 风云三

fysjmb.description: 一个以古龙小说为背景的"风云Ⅳ"MUD（Sumxin 风云），和本合集里的`xsfyssjb`（心声风云四升级版）是同一套代码库——`d/dreamland/`等场景文件逐字节相同，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。
fysjmb.english_description: A “Storm IV” MUD (Sumxin Storm) set in the world of Gu Long's novels. It shares the same codebase as this collection's xsfyssjb (“Heart's Voice Storm IV Upgraded Edition”) — the d/dreamland/ area and other scene files are byte-for-byte identical — though neither archive had previously documented this relationship.
fysjmb.name: 风云四解密版

fyzfqyy.description: 一个以古龙小说为背景的"风云"MUD。
fyzfqyy.english_description: A “Storm” MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels.
fyzfqyy.name: 风云之风起云涌

gjzddmudda.description: 一个 ES2 血统的 MUD（作者自己在横幅中致谢 Annihilator/ES2），游戏内标题为"葫芦Ⅱ / Demon Angel"（泥潭中国简化版本）。
gjzddmudda.english_description: An ES2-lineage MUD (the author credits Annihilator/ES2 in the login banner). Its in-game title is “Gourd II / Demon Angel” — a simplified Chinese-language adaptation.
gjzddmudda.name: 国家制度的MUD DA

haiyang2.archive: 海洋II 2010 正式无错完整版下载 (1).rar
haiyang2.description: 本游戏自称 **海洋II**，游戏内还有一个更常用的招牌名字——**星月传奇**。属于经典的 "ES II" 引擎家族（与本项目中的 es1_win、xkx2001、rzrmud、xo、武汉站、炎黄武魂等同宗），是当年一批中文武侠 MUD 中流传较广的一支。`hymud`（海洋V·星月传奇）是它的独立演化续作。
haiyang2.english_description: The game calls itself Ocean II, though its more commonly used in-game name is Star and Moon Legend. It belongs to the classic “ES II” engine family (shared lineage with es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, xo, Wuhan Station, and Legend of the Yellow Emperor's Soul in this project) and was one of the more widely circulated Chinese wuxia MUDs of its era. hymud (Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend) is its independent successor.
haiyang2.name: 海洋II

hc.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `红尘.rar`（游戏内全名"红尘录"）。ES II 引擎家族的一支独立作品。
hc.english_description: Sourced from a 红尘.rar (hongchen.rar) archive within a 2026-07-29 batch upload; its full in-game title is “Chronicle of the Red Dust” (红尘录). It is an independent work within the ES II engine family.
hc.name: 红尘

hell.description: 游戏内标题为 "REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.11.13"（作者自称"doing"），是一个 Doing 血统的大型金庸题材 mudlib（超过 7000 个LPC 文件）。
hell.english_description: The in-game title is “Revive of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic) from 1999.11.13” (the author calls themselves “doing”). It's a large Jin Yong-themed mudlib in the “Doing” lineage, comprising more than 7,000 LPC files.
hell.name: 终极地狱之地狱无门 (hell)

hhsj.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `洪荒世界(自连数据库)`。与`nitan170911`（仙剑奇侠传）、`nitan6`（笑傲江湖）同源的 NT/nitan/Lonely引擎家族成员，这次以《封神演义》/盘古开天为背景重新设计。
hhsj.english_description: Sourced from a “Primordial World (Self-Connecting Database)” archive within a 2026-07-29 batch upload. A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family — related to nitan170911 (Chinese Paladin) and nitan6 (Laughing in the Wind) in this project — redesigned here around the world of Investiture of the Gods and the myth of Pangu separating heaven and earth.
hhsj.name: 洪荒世界

huoying.description: 本游戏自称 **火影**（英文 Naruto），底层引擎注释自称 `Neolith 0.0.2`，是 "ES2" 引擎家族的一员（与本项目中的武汉站、雪影奇缘等同宗）。以日本动漫《火影忍者》为题材，玩家扮演忍者角色，登录界面带有相当精美的ANSI 彩色 ASCII 艺术 Logo。
huoying.english_description: The game calls itself Huoying (Naruto); its underlying engine identifies itself in comments as “Neolith 0.0.2,” and it belongs to the “ES2” engine family (shared lineage with Wuhan Station and Xueying Qiyuan in this project). Themed after the Japanese anime Naruto, players take on the role of a ninja, and the login screen features a fairly elaborate ANSI color ASCII-art logo.
huoying.name: 火影

hxxtjqb.description: 游戏内标题为"西行战记"（MudOS v22pre11 MudLib Build 3310），一个西游记题材的传统 GB/BIG5 双编码 ES 血统 mudlib。
hxxtjqb.english_description: The in-game title is “Chronicle of the Journey West” (MudOS v22pre11 MudLib Build 3310) — a traditional GB/BIG5 dual-encoding ES-lineage mudlib themed after Journey to the West.
hxxtjqb.name: 幻想西天加强版

hy.description: 以"金庸小说背景"为世界观的武侠 MUD（请勿使用小说中人名），社区名"情义盟"。
hy.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Jin Yong's novels (though players are asked not to reuse character names from the novels themselves). Its community calls itself the “Alliance of Loyalty and Righteousness” (Qingyimeng).
hy.name: 海洋（基础版）

hy2000.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），ES2/金庸题材血统的 mudlib。和`fqyy2`（风起云涌2）同属"海洋/hy"代码线家族（`SECURITY_D` 都指向`adm/daemons/securd.lpc`）。
hy2000.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II — an ES2/Jin Yong-themed mudlib. It belongs to the “Ocean/hy” code family alongside fqyy2 (Storm Rising 2) in this project — both point their SECURITY_D to adm/daemons/securd.lpc.
hy2000.name: 海洋2000 (hy2000)

hy2002.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），是 [hy2000](../hy2000/) 的后续/演进版本——两者 10630/10632 个文件按路径完全重合，hy2002 在此基础上新增了约 3000 个文件（新地图、新门派内容等）。
hy2002.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II, and it's a follow-on, evolved version of hy2000 in this project — the two share 10,630 of 10,632 files by path, with hy2002 adding roughly 3,000 new files on top (new maps, new sect content, and more).
hy2002.name: 海洋2002 (hy2002)

hy3.description: 游戏内标题为"火云录2000"（Huo Yun Lu 2000），ES/金庸题材血统的mudlib。
hy3.english_description: The in-game title is Fire Cloud Chronicle 2000 (火云录2000) — an ES/Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite sharing the “hy” prefix with hy, hy2000, and hy2002 (the “Ocean”-titled family) in this project, file-by-file comparison of the core master.lpc, securd.lpc, and securityd.lpc confirms it is not the same lineage — the two families merely happen to both be ES2-derived, Jin Yong-themed wuxia MUDs. hy3's master.lpc has an entirely different structure (credited to “change by xhh,” 363 lines, versus the three byte-identical 332-line “for ES II mudlib” versions in the hy family), and its wizard directories under u/ (xingyun, xingyu, hsly) point to an independently maintained codebase.
hy3.name: 火云 (hy3)

hy5.description: "海洋"系列的另一支代码线（与 146/hy 同源但代码内容已大幅分叉，行数差异很大，不能假设两者的具体修复位置/行号一致）。世界观为武侠向，社区自称"海洋V"。§10.7 深度功能测试独立确认：`adm/obj/master.lpc` 与 146/hy 逐字节完全相同，但 `adm/daemons/securd.lpc`（安全精灵）已被独立重写——两者共享同一份原始代码根源，但安全模型的具体实现形状完全不同，任何移植过来的修法都必须重新对照本档案自己的代码确认，见 NOTES.md。
hy5.english_description: Another branch of the “Ocean” code line — related to hy in this project but heavily diverged in content (line counts differ substantially, so fixes cannot be assumed to sit at matching locations). It's a wuxia-themed world whose community calls itself “Ocean V.” Its adm/obj/master.lpc is byte-identical to hy's, but its security daemon (adm/daemons/securd.lpc) has been independently rewritten — the two share a common source root, but their security models diverge considerably in implementation.
hy5.name: 海洋5

hyiishzdscbb.archive: 海洋II上海站第三次版本.rar
hyiishzdscbb.description: 游戏内标题为"海洋II"（Ocean II），是 [hy2000](../hy2000/)/[hy2002](../hy2002/) 的另一个兄弟版本（约 9600/10253 个文件按路径与两者分别重合）——同一套 ES2/金庸题材代码血统的上海站第三次版本快照。
hyiishzdscbb.english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II, and it's a sibling version to hy2000 and hy2002 in this project (sharing roughly 9,600 and 10,253 files by path with each, respectively) — a snapshot of the third version deployed on the Shanghai server, from the same ES2/Jin Yong-themed codebase.
hyiishzdscbb.name: 海洋II上海站第三次版本 (hyiishzdscbb)

hymud.description: 本游戏自称 **海洋V**，游戏内招牌名字为 **星月传奇**（登录后横幅显示〖海洋V-星月传奇〗）。属于经典的 "ES II" 引擎家族的 **海洋II** 一支的后续版本（与本项目中的 haiyang2/海洋II 同源，是它的独立演化版本）。本项目迄今处理过的最大一个压缩包（工作目录内约 5.7 万个源码文件）。
hymud.english_description: The game calls itself Ocean V, with the in-game banner name Star and Moon Legend (displayed as 〈Ocean V — Star and Moon Legend〉 on login). It's a successor within the classic “ES II” engine family's Ocean II branch — an independent evolution of haiyang2 (Ocean II) in this project — and is the largest archive processed in this project to date, with roughly 57,000 source files in its working directory.
hymud.english_name: Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend
hymud.name: 海洋V·星月传奇

jh2006.description: 游戏内标题为"江湖2005"（Annihilator/书剑 ES2 血统），金庸题材mudlib。
jh2006.english_description: The in-game title is Jianghu 2005 (Annihilator/Book-and-Sword ES2 lineage), a Jin Yong-themed mudlib.
jh2006.name: 江湖2006 (jh2006)

jhfy.description: 本游戏自称 **江湖风云单机**。经过与本项目内另外两个同源作品（夕阳再现·疯狂江湖、未明空间）的核心文件比对，确认三者同出一脉，都源自"夕阳再现之江湖风云"这一支中文武侠 MUD 血脉——本作在三者中与共同祖先最接近，可以看作这一系列的核心版本。这一支和另一轮处理过的 `xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
jhfy.english_description: The game calls itself Jianghu Storm: Single-Player Edition. Core-file comparison against two related titles in this project (Sunset Reappears: Frenzied Jianghu, and Unknown Space) confirms all three descend from the same lineage — the “Sunset Reappears: Jianghu Storm” branch of Chinese wuxia MUDs — with this version standing closest to their common ancestor, making it the core release of the series. This is the same true “Sunset Reappears” lineage as xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412 handled elsewhere in this project; note that a separate, unrelated “Tianya” family of archives (xysylmhb, xyzxiiylzymh, yzxiiizylfy, xyzx3, etc.) also carries “Sunset Reappears” branding despite having an entirely different map — the brand name alone isn't a reliable lineage signal.
jhfy.name: 江湖风云

jhfy2.description: 游戏内标题为"江湖风云II 之 辽宁风云再起"，金庸题材 mudlib。地图目录结构和"天涯"家族（`tybxjh`/`xhcii`/`zxty`/`ffxymud`）几乎一致，`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）内容也相同（本档案这份文件被排版格式化工具误加空格，但核心内容确认逐字对应），是这批档案里第六个确认的成员，此前没有任何一份档案互相记录过这层关系。
jhfy2.english_description: In-game titled "Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II: Liaoning Storm Rising," a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Its map directory structure nearly matches this project's "Tianya" (Ends of the Earth) family (tybxjh, xhcii, zxty, ffxymud), and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is identical in content (a formatting tool added stray spaces to this copy, but the core text matches word for word) — making it the sixth confirmed member of that family, a relationship no archive had previously recorded.
jhfy2.english_name: Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II
jhfy2.name: 江湖风云2 (jhfy2)

jhfy3.description: 游戏内标题为"夕阳再现 之「风云再起Ⅱ」"，是 [jhfy2](../jhfy2/) 的后续/扩展版本（7977/9332 个 jhfy2 文件按路径重合，jhfy3 在此基础上大幅扩充了内容），金庸题材 mudlib。虽然文件路径和 `jhfy2` 高度重合，但这份档案的 `d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）实际上和 `jhfy2`所属的"天涯"家族版本不同，而是和 `xajh4gkb`（笑傲江湖4公开版，同样打着"夕阳再现"旗号）、`xyzx`（夕阳再现，同一品牌的源头版本之一）逐字节相同——说明"夕阳再现"是独立于"天涯"的另一个代码血统，这份档案是站在 `jhfy2` 的地图基础上、换用了"夕阳再现"这一支的核心系统文件。
jhfy3.english_description: In-game titled "Sunset Reappears: Storm Rising II," a sequel/expansion of this project's jhfy2 (7,977 of jhfy2's 9,332 files overlap by path, with jhfy3 substantially expanding on that base), a Jin Yong-themed mudlib. Despite the heavy file-path overlap with jhfy2, this archive's "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is actually byte-identical not to jhfy2's "Tianya" family version but to xajh4gkb (Xiao'ao Jianghu 4, Public Edition, which also carries the "Sunset Reappears" brand) and xyzx (one of the original "Sunset Reappears" releases) — showing that "Sunset Reappears" is a separate code lineage from "Tianya," and that this archive builds on jhfy2's map while swapping in "Sunset Reappears" core system files.
jhfy3.name: 江湖风云3 (jhfy3)

jinyongwenzi.description: 源文件包名为"金庸文字版"。经比对确认，这与本项目中的"bxsj"（书剑天下）、"bxsj1" 是**同一套代码库**的不同历史快照，属于同一支血脉的武侠 MUD。取名自金庸小说《书剑恩仇录》。
jinyongwenzi.english_description: The original package was named "Jin Yong Text Edition." Comparison confirms this is the same codebase as this project's bxsj (Book and Sword: World of Jianghu) and bxsj1 — different historical snapshots of the same wuxia MUD lineage — named after Jin Yong's novel The Book and the Sword.
jinyongwenzi.name: 书剑2002

jqxz2008.description: 本游戏自称 **金庸群侠传**，本压缩包对应"2008加强版"这一内容版本。属于"ES II"引擎家族的一个独立分支（源自作者 Phoebus.suny 1998 年的 ES2"天曹地国"版本），本项目中还收录了同一引擎核心的另外两个内容版本（标准版、超豪华版、2015版），可以理解为"同一套服务端程序，不同的关卡/内容配置"。
jqxz2008.english_description: Self-titled "Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes," this archive corresponds to the "2008 Enhanced" content release. It's an independent branch of the "ES II" engine family (tracing to author Phoebus.suny's 1998 ES2 "Heavenly Court, Earthly Realm" release); this project also holds other content releases built on the same engine core (Standard, Deluxe, and 2015 editions) — essentially the same server program with different content configurations.
jqxz2008.english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Enhanced Edition)
jqxz2008.name: 金庸群侠传（2008 加强版）

jqxz2008dlx.description: 本压缩包对应"2008超豪华版"这一内容版本，与本项目中的"2008加强版""2008标准版"是完全相同的服务端引擎核心，但在门派 NPC、战斗数值配置、部分地图场景上有独立的内容调整，文件规模也是三者中最大的一个。
jqxz2008dlx.english_description: This archive corresponds to the "2008 Deluxe" content release, sharing an identical server engine core with this project's "2008 Enhanced" and "2008 Standard" editions, but with its own adjustments to sect NPCs, combat numbers, and some map scenes — and the largest file size of the three.
jqxz2008dlx.english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Deluxe Edition)
jqxz2008dlx.name: 金庸群侠传（2008 超豪华版）

jqxz2008std.description: 本压缩包对应"2008版"（标准版），与本项目中的"金庸群侠传2008加强版"是完全相同的服务端引擎核心（master、登录、安全模块等关键文件逐字节一致），仅任务数量和个别场景描写比加强版更精简。
jqxz2008std.english_description: This archive corresponds to the base "2008" (Standard) content release, sharing an identical server engine core with this project's "2008 Enhanced" edition (the master, login, and security modules match byte for byte), with only somewhat fewer quests and lighter scene descriptions than the Enhanced edition.
jqxz2008std.english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Standard Edition)
jqxz2008std.name: 金庸群侠传（2008 标准版）

jqxz2015.description: 2015 年整理发布的版本，属于 ES II 引擎系列——与本项目中的"金庸群侠传2008加强版"等同门作品共享同一套底层引擎/守护进程代码，七年间引擎本身几乎没有变化，变化的主要是游戏内容，本版比 2008 版新增了不少区域和剧情。
jqxz2015.english_description: A version compiled and released in 2015, part of the ES II engine series — sharing the same underlying engine/daemon code with this project's "2008 Enhanced" edition and its siblings. The engine itself changed little over those seven years; what changed was the content, with this edition adding a number of new areas and storylines beyond the 2008 release.
jqxz2015.english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2015 Edition)
jqxz2015.name: 金庸群侠传（2015版）

jym.description: 以金庸小说世界观为背景的武侠 MUD。地图目录结构和 111`xkx2000zxb`（侠客行2000最新版，MudOS v22b25 世系）高度重合——`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景内容相同，只是文件头的"破解"署名不同（`xkx2000zxb` 是"Cracked by Kafei"，这份档案是"Cracked byRoath"），应是同一款"侠客行I"底层代码库的不同流通版本，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。`xkm`（侠客梦）和 `bmxkx2001`（侠客行北美2001版）也是同一批"Cracked by Roath"流通版本的手足档案。
jym.english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Jin Yong's novels. Its map directory structure heavily overlaps with this project's xkx2000zxb (Ode to Gallantry 2000, Latest Edition, MudOS v22b25 lineage) — scenes such as the ancestral hall at the Lake Tai ancient tomb are identical, differing only in the "cracked by" credit in the file headers ("Cracked by Kafei" there versus "Cracked by Roath" here) — indicating both are different circulating copies of the same underlying "Ode to Gallantry I" codebase, a relationship neither archive had previously recorded. xkm (Ode to Gallantry's Dream) and bmxkx2001 (Ode to Gallantry, North America 2001 Edition) are sibling archives from the same "Cracked by Roath" release line.
jym.name: 金庸梦

jyqxc.description: 游戏内标题为 "The Story of Hero"，金庸题材 mudlib。
jyqxc.english_description: In-game titled "The Story of Hero," a Jin Yong-themed mudlib that shares a common master.lpc with this project's jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, fy2mg, and xkx2017 (the "Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes"/XKX framework family), with a relatively compact map spanning sects like Mount Hua, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, and the Ming Cult.
jyqxc.name: 金庸群侠传 (jyqxc)

jyqxc2.description: [jyqxc](../jyqxc/) 的姊妹版本（编号 086/087）。**经 2026-08-05 的§10.7 深度功能测试用 `diff -rq` 逐文件核对，确认二者实质上是同一份原始数据的两份几乎完整的快照，不是"架构相同、内容各异"的独立衍生档**（这条结论纠正了本文件此前的描述）——详见下方「内容亮点」。
jyqxc2.english_description: A sibling archive to this project's jyqxc (numbers 086/087). A file-by-file diff confirmed the two are, in essence, two near-complete snapshots of the same original data rather than independently developed variants sharing only the same architecture — of roughly 3,690 files in each "work" tree, only a handful differ (a not-yet-patched login script, two runtime logs, and each one's leftover test character), while the death system and other core files are byte-for-byte identical. The archive filenames even show the classic browser double-download pattern, suggesting both came from the same original download that this project's deduplication process didn't catch.
jyqxc2.name: 金庸群侠传 (jyqxc2)

jyqxc2013fwq.description: [jyqxc](../jyqxc/)/[jyqxc2](../jyqxc2/) 同一架构家族的另一份存档（2013 年服务器版），文件内容大部分不同，但整体结构和已知 bug 面基本一致。
jyqxc2013fwq.english_description: Another archive in the same architecture family as this project's jyqxc and jyqxc2 (a 2013 server-side release) — most of its file content differs, but the overall structure and known bug surface are essentially the same. Unlike jyqxc2's relationship to jyqxc, a file-by-file diff confirmed this is a genuinely independent snapshot rather than a byte-identical duplicate, with its own unique bugs including a stray angle-bracket #include path that once crashed every score command.
jyqxc2013fwq.english_name: The Story of Hero (2013 Server Edition)
jyqxc2013fwq.name: 金庸群侠传2013_服务器版 (jyqxc2013fwq)

kxkj.description: 游戏配置和进游戏后的横幅上写的都是《狂想空间》，压缩包文件名里的"新狂想空间II"其实是收藏站点自己加的标题，并非游戏本名。这是一套1995 年起源自"ES II"（Eastern Stories II）架构的老牌 Mud 引擎，2002 年由台湾巫师 wade 发布，与本项目里的 es1_win、esI、xkx2001、辽宁热线站等多个库同属 ES II 大家族。
kxkj.english_description: Both the game configuration and the in-game banner call it "Rhapsody Realm" — the archive filename's "New Rhapsody Realm II" is a title the collecting site added, not the game's real name. It's a venerable mudlib engine dating to 1995 ("ES II" / Eastern Stories II architecture), released in 2002 by Taiwanese wizard wade, and belongs to the same large ES II family as this project's es1_win, esI, xkx2001, and Liaoning Hotline Station archives, among others.
kxkj.name: 狂想空间

kxkj1.description: 1995 年 9 月 22 日创建的老牌台湾 MUD（创始团队 wade、shorst、jcder等），属于 ES II 引擎系列（与本项目中的 es1_win、esI、xkx2001、rzrmud、侠客行系列等同宗）。本项目中还有另一个档案"新狂想空间II"（增加了邮箱注册等更新内容），两者虽然都自称"狂想空间"，但经比对是两个不同时期、独立流传的版本。本档案是相对更早的一个存档快照。
kxkj1.english_description: A venerable Taiwanese MUD founded September 22, 1995 (by wade, shorst, jcder, and others), part of the ES II engine series shared with this project's es1_win, esI, xkx2001, rzrmud, and the Ode to Gallantry series. This project also holds another archive that likewise calls itself "Rhapsody Realm" (with added features like email registration) — comparison shows the two are independently circulated versions from different eras, and this is the earlier of the two snapshots.
kxkj1.name: 狂想空间

kxkjii2.description: ES II/Annihilator 系架构衍生的 mudlib，和 jyqxc 系列不是同一血统（存档用驱动原生的明文格式，不是那一系的旧式二进制格式）。
kxkjii2.english_description: A mudlib derived from the ES II/Annihilator architecture line, a different lineage from the jyqxc family (it uses the driver's native plaintext save format rather than that family's old binary format). A diff against this project's kxkj (#036, "Rhapsody Realm") shows byte-identical master.lpc, securityd.lpc, and death-system files — not an adaptation or sequel, but another independent snapshot of the same 2002 release by Taiwanese wizard wade, differing by only about 10 runtime files. Each archive independently built its own newbie zone under the shared name "Snow Village," with different actual content — evidence of two separately built instances of the same engine source rather than one being derived from the other.
kxkjii2.name: 狂想空间II (kxkjii2)

ldtx.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `鹿鼎天下.rar`。"世纪(Century) / adm-single" 引擎家族的一支（与 `shiji`、`shujian2008`、`xjcq2000`、`xkxz2`、`xiakexing100` 同源），ES II 血统。
ldtx.english_description: From the "Deer and Cauldron World.rar" archive within a 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib collection. Part of the "Century (Shiji) / adm-single" engine family (sharing lineage with this project's shiji, shujian2008, xjcq2000, xkxz2, and xiakexing100), itself descended from ES II. Curiously, the archive itself is named "Deer and Cauldron World," but the login banner actually brands the game "Xiongba Tianxia (Hero's Dominion), Xi'an Station," while the quit message says "you have left Deer and Cauldron World" — both names linger in the code, suggesting an incomplete rebrand at some point in its history.
ldtx.name: 鹿鼎天下（游戏内实际品牌：雄霸天下『西安站』）

ldtxii.description: [ldtx](../ldtx/) 的姊妹版本（同一个 Century/adm-single 架构家族，但绝大多数内容不同，不是文件级重复）。
ldtxii.english_description: A sibling release to this project's ldtx, sharing the same Century/adm-single architecture family but with mostly independent content rather than file-level duplication. Despite a login banner and BBS links inherited from an unrelated "Xiongba Tianxia" engine template, a codebase search confirms the actual game content is genuinely themed around Jin Yong's novel The Deer and the Cauldron, with 48 files referencing characters and factions like Wei Xiaobao, the Divine Dragon Cult, and Emperor Kangxi.
ldtxii.name: 鹿鼎天下II (ldtxii)

longyunmeng.archive: 龙云梦-炎龙封印源码版.rar
longyunmeng.description: 作者 Wenwu，属于"夕阳再现/炎龙封印"（XYZX/YLFY）引擎家族的一个独立分支——与本项目中的 `ylfyxa3`（炎龙封印·笑傲江湖阿飞站）同宗但各自独立演化，并非同一份内容的翻版；也和另一轮处理过的`xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同）——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
longyunmeng.english_description: By author Wenwu, an independent branch within the "Sunset Reappears / Flame Dragon Seal" (XYZX/YLFY) engine family — related to but separately evolved from this project's ylfyxa3 (Flame Dragon Seal: Smiling Proud Wanderer, Afei Station), not a reskin of the same content. It shares the genuine "Sunset Reappears" code lineage (a byte-identical d/city/sj.lpc) with xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412; note that several other archives in this project also carry the "Sunset Reappears" brand but belong to an entirely different "Tianya" map lineage, so the brand name alone is not a reliable guide to actual codebase ancestry.
longyunmeng.english_name: Dragon Cloud Dream: Flame Dragon Seal (Source Edition)
longyunmeng.name: 龙云梦·炎龙封印（源码版）

mhxy.description: 青岛站，自 2002 年 1 月 15 日起运行，隶属于经典的"西游记"引擎家族（与本项目转换的 xyj2000f 等同源），底层引擎标注为MudOS V22Pre11。
mhxy.english_description: Running as the "Qingdao Station" branch since January 15, 2002, part of the classic Journey to the West-themed engine family (sharing lineage with this project's xyj2000f, among others), built on a MudOS V22Pre11-labeled core.
mhxy.name: 梦幻西游 (mhxy)

mhxyqd.description: 2002 年版本，"青岛站"分线。与本项目中的 "mhxy" 是同一套 2002 年代码库（仅站点名称品牌不同），属于西游记题材、ES II 引擎家族的一支（与xyj2000f 等同宗）。
mhxyqd.english_description: A 2002 release under the "Qingdao Station" branch — the same 2002 codebase as this project's mhxy archive (differing only in station branding), part of the Journey to the West-themed ES II engine family shared with xyj2000f, among others.
mhxyqd.name: 梦幻西游（青岛站）

mnhf.description: 以广州市华南师范大学附属中学为背景设定的校园题材 mudlib。
mnhf.english_description: A campus-life simulation mudlib set at the real-world campus of South China Normal University's Affiliated High School (Huafu) in Guangzhou. Unlike other campus-themed games in this collection, it has no wuxia or fantasy trappings — its map faithfully recreates real school locations like classroom buildings, dormitories, the computer room, and the library.
mnhf.name: 模拟华附 (mnhf)

mohuanshiji.description: 青岛站，作者"小宝(suannai)/西瓜太郎(gslxz)/桃心太郎"，由"星月传奇"发布。属于"神话西游"(SJXY) 一脉，是 ES II 引擎的一个西游记（Journeyto the West）改版分支，与本项目转换的 mhxy/rzrmud 等同为"西游记"神话世界观，但代码血统各自独立，并非彼此的换皮版本。
mohuanshiji.english_description: A Qingdao-hosted branch of the 'Mythic Journey West' (SJXY) family, built on the ES II engine as an independent take on the Journey to the West mythos — sharing the same setting as sibling games mhxy and rzrmud in this collection but with its own separate codebase. New characters set out from the South City Inn, greeted by classic figures like Tang Sanzang and the inn's waiter as NPCs; the game layers in original sects such as Wudang and Yihua Palace not found in the source novel, making it one of the more content-rich entries in this sub-genre.
mohuanshiji.name: 魔幻世纪 (mohuanshiji)

niaoren.description: 登录横幅标注底层为 `MudOS v22c2` / `MudOs V22pre11`。深度功能测试确认了它的血统：和 `cctx`（驰骋天下）是同一套源码的独立分支——注册流程的天赋选择提示文字逐字相同（"俠馳騁江湖中的人物大多具有..."），`adm/daemons/logind.lpc` 里至今还留着一行`read_file("/adm/etc/cctxinfo")`，"cctxinfo" 这个档案名本身就是`cctx` 的残留痕迹，从未在改名/重新包装成"鳥人世界"品牌的过程中被清理掉。之前被标记为"未分类"，diff 确认过和 `xkx2001`/`xuanjianlu`（XKX 家族）不是同一血统，只是当时没找对真正的手足档案。
niaoren.english_description: A Traditional Chinese wuxia MUD drawing its plots and riddles from Jin Yong's fifteen novels. Players start out at the Dragon Gate Inn and make their way through sects and cities across the jianghu, training internal power, external martial arts, and other skills along the way — a classic wuxia framework of stats, sects, master-disciple bonds, guilds, and rankings. Deep testing traced its lineage back to cctx (Chi Cheng Tian Xia), an independent branch descended from the same original codebase.
niaoren.name: 鳥人世界 (The Bird-Man World)

nitan170911.description: 底层标注"NTLIB V7.1x"，是本项目转换的"泥潭/nitan/Lonely"系列引擎中体量最大的一个（约 5.4 万个文件），取材于同名经典仙侠游戏/电视剧的世界观。与体量稍小的 nitan6（笑傲江湖）同源，共享同一套 F_DBASE 属性存取架构。
nitan170911.english_description: The largest of the 'nitan' (NT/Lonely) engine family games in this collection, weighing in at roughly 54,000 files. Set in the world of the beloved Chinese Paladin / Sword and Fairy (Xianjian Qixia Zhuan) game and TV franchise, it shares its core attribute-storage architecture with its smaller sibling nitan6 (Laughing in the Wind). Its account system depends on an external MySQL server for cross-site character syncing, so in this archived environment new registration is gracefully declined rather than broken — it's best explored by browsing the code and world content rather than played start to finish.
nitan170911.name: 仙剑奇侠传 (nitan170911)

nitan6.description: 底层标注"NT.XAJH Library 5.1g" / "NTOS V2.4"，属于本项目中体量最大的两个"泥潭/nitan/Lonely"系列引擎库之一（与 nitan170911 同源，后者需要外部 MySQL 支持，本库不需要）。取材于金庸同名武侠小说的江湖世界。
nitan6.english_description: One of the two largest 'nitan' (NT/Lonely) engine games in this collection, at over 23,000 files, based on Jin Yong's classic wuxia novel The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. Characters are reincarnated from the Valley of Life into a full Jin-Yong-style jianghu of sects — Sun Moon Sect, Mount Hua, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, and more — building up internal power, lightness kung fu, fist skills, and weapon mastery, with gang prestige, military merit, marriage, and mounts all fleshed out. The Beggars' Sect even has its own quirky tree-hollow initiation ritual, and a one-shot 'wash' command lets players fully re-roll their starting attributes.
nitan6.name: 笑傲江湖 (nitan6)

nitan_ceshi.description: 站点内部配置自称"泥潭三"(nitan.3)，但连线后看到的实际招牌是《終極魔界》("Ultimate Demon Realm")——一个套在"泥潭"引擎上的主题皮肤。属于 NT/nitan/Lonely 一脉（与本项目转换的 nitan170911、nitan6、nitan_san 同源），是这条脉络里比较早期的一个内部快照版本。
nitan_ceshi.english_description: An early internal test snapshot from the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage (shared with sibling games nitan170911, nitan6, and nitan_san in this collection), internally labeled 'Mire 3' but branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm' — a thematic skin layered over the nitan engine. New characters choose a name and personality, reroll their stats, and are then delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life, following the setting's creation-myth cosmology. Unlike its relative nitan170911, this branch needs no external MySQL database — everything runs on local files, so the full registration-to-gameplay flow works out of the box.
nitan_ceshi.name: 泥潭III测试版 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_ceshi)

nitan_san.description: 站点内部自称"泥潭"(nitan)，是 NT/nitan/Lonely 系列真正的"三代"正宗版本（登陆横幅本身就打出"一入泥潭深似海"字样，驱动版本标注"MudOS v22.2b14 NT-Build"）。实际连线看到的招牌是《終極魔界》，与它的近亲 nitan_ceshi 一样是套在"泥潭"引擎上的一层皮肤。
nitan_san.english_description: The true 'third generation' release of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage — its login banner literally reads 'once you enter the Mire, it runs as deep as the sea.' Like its close relative nitan_ceshi, it's branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared nitan engine. Character creation follows the same creation-myth path: choose a name and personality, reroll stats, and be delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life. It shares its sibling's independence from any external database, though the two branches evolved separately and each carries its own small quirks.
nitan_san.name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_san)

njhhdxdes2hx.archive: 南京河海大学的es2和xkx《校内_1.01版》.tar.gz
njhhdxdes2hx.description: ES2/侠客行系混血引擎，南京河海大学计算机学院测试版，注册流程简单直接（无需 `new` 关键字，任意未使用的英文 id 都会触发新角色确认）。
njhhdxdes2hx.english_description: A hybrid of the ES2 and Xiake Xing ('The Wandering Knight') engine lineages, built as a computer-science-department test build at Hohai University in Nanjing. The content is still a work in progress, but the world already has personality — the pawnshop owner in Snow Pavilion Town is secretly a hidden master far stronger than any other early-game NPC, while the doorkeeper at the Chunfeng martial arts hall only fights seriously against his own sect's disciples, pulling his punches against everyone else.
njhhdxdes2hx.english_name: Eastern Story II x Xiake Xing (Hohai University Campus Edition)
njhhdxdes2hx.name: 东方故事II ＋ 侠客行 (南京河海大学校内版1.01)

nt1.description: NT/nitan 系代码线（与 nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj 无精确 master-hash 匹配，独立代码线）。
nt1.english_description: An independent branch of the NT/nitan ('Mire') engine family — deep testing found no exact code match to sibling games nitan170911, nitan6, or hhsj, confirming it grew up on its own. New characters must first pass through a 'registration room' and use a built-in register-with-email command before their attributes are even assigned, an extra gate reminiscent of the 'reincarnation' step found in the Hell/Doing family of games. Character creation also layers a temperament type and a character-class type on top of the usual gender choice.
nt1.name: 泥潭1

nt6.description: NT/nitan 血统 mudlib（与 nitan170911/nitan6 同源但非字节级相同），一个以创世神话（盘古开天、太极两仪）为背景的大型武侠 mudlib，共23000+ 个 `.lpc` 文件。
nt6.english_description: A large NT/nitan ('Mire') lineage wuxia mudlib built on a creation myth — Pangu splitting heaven and earth, yin and yang emerging from chaos — and spanning over 23,000 source files, making it one of the largest games in this collection. Its signature touch is a 'birth ceremony': after registering, a new character isn't considered fully 'born' until they travel to the Registration realm and complete a ritual dialogue with mythic NPCs like Pangu and Ksitigarbha, weaving the tutorial gate directly into the game's own mythology rather than just an email-confirmation step.
nt6.name: 泥潭6 (nt6)

nt6nitan6win.description: [nt6](../nt6/) 的同源版本（同一个 lineage/master hash，本次修复涉及的每一个档案都和 nt6 修复前逐字节相同），无数据库（win_nodb）变体。
nt6nitan6win.english_description: A same-lineage variant of nt6 (Mire 6), packaged as a database-free 'win_nodb' build — every file touched by this project's fixes was byte-for-byte identical to nt6's pre-fix version. It shares nt6's sprawling map, stretching from the central Chinese heartland cities of Chang'an and Luoyang out to Annam (Vietnam), Korea, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, plus its own dedicated 'reborn' area layered onto the same registration-room mechanic.
nt6nitan6win.name: 泥潭6 win_nodb版 (nt6nitan6win)

nte.description: ES2/Annihilator 系架构衍生的武侠 mudlib（"泥潭"系列的一支，和nt6/nitan 血统的 dbase 架构 bug 无关——这份档案自己的`feature/dbase.lpc` 本来就有完整的 `set`/`query`/`delete` 实现）。共 13000+ 个 `.lpc` 文件。
nte.english_description: A wuxia mudlib built on the ES2/Annihilator engine lineage, part of the broader 'Mire' (nitan/NT) family but with its own independently written attribute-storage code — it doesn't share the nt6/nt1 branch's architecture bugs. At roughly 13,000 source files, it has its own version of the 'birth ceremony' registration ritual seen in nt6, right down to matching file names, an interesting case of convergent design within the same broader engine scene despite being coded independently.
nte.name: 泥潭二 (nte)

ntii.description: [nte](../nte/) 的同架构家族版本（ES2/Annihilator 系），本次修复涉及的档案（`logind.lpc`、`named.lpc`、`versiond.lpc`、`dns_master.lpc`、`clone/user/user.lpc`）和 nte 修复前逐字节相同——不是整个 lib 的重复（全库 10731/14000+ 个档案不同，主要是游戏内容），但这几个基础设施档案是共用的。
ntii.english_description: A sibling build in the same ES2/Annihilator-engine family as nte (Mire 2), sharing several core infrastructure files byte-for-byte with it — the login, naming, and version-sync daemons — while the roughly 10,000 remaining files of actual game content were developed independently. Like nte, it gates full 'born' status behind a creation-myth NPC dialogue ritual rather than a simple registration step.
ntii.name: 泥潭II (ntii)

qhxajh.description: 和 019（xo，迷你版）、019-1（xo_final，最终版）同属 TMI-2/ES2/Falcon 系引擎家族，是清华大学版本的《笑傲江湖》，门派/剧情内容与前两者不同。
qhxajh.english_description: A Tsinghua University take on Jin Yong's The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, sharing the TMI-2/ES2/Falcon engine family with sibling games xo and xo_final in this collection but built with independently developed sects and story content, centered on the 'Nanyang' region map and noticeably more compact than the xo series. New character names are filtered against a blocklist of Jin Yong novel character names, so players can't register as the original book's own protagonists. Combat writing is unusually detailed, with distinct flavor text for hits, parries, and dodges.
qhxajh.name: 清华笑傲江湖 (qhxajh)

rzrmud.description: 站点自称"YWX人造人"（原开发者的昵称/团队名），北美总站，自 2006 年2 月 3 日运行至今（存档信息显示已有五百多个注册玩家）。与本项目转换的"梦幻西游"(mhxy) 同属西游记神话世界观的一支，但引擎实现是独立的一支（不使用 nitan/Lonely 家族那套全局属性存取机制，而是每个对象自带属性存取方法，架构上更规范）。
rzrmud.english_description: A North America-hosted Journey to the West game, self-branded 'YWX Cyborg' after its original developer/team, continuously running since February 2006 with over five hundred registered player accounts on record — among the most solidly 'actually operated' archives in this collection. It shares its mythic Journey to the West setting with sibling game mhxy but runs on an independently engineered codebase, with per-object attribute accessors rather than the shared global-store architecture common to the nitan/Lonely family. New characters begin at the South City Inn in Chang'an, greeted by classic characters like Bai Suzhen and Tang Sanzang, and follow a cultivation-focused progression built around sects, Five Elements attack/defense attributes, and Taoist cultivation realms, with a fairly generous newbie starter-kit system.
rzrmud.name: 大唐西游 YWX人造人 (rzrmud)

sanjieshenhua.description: 与 `sjcs`（三界传说）标题相近，但为独立开发的不同代码库（核心文件差异巨大，非同一引擎的分支）。
sanjieshenhua.english_description: A mythology-themed mudlib set across the 'Three Realms' cosmology, distinct in its underlying codebase from the similarly-named sjcs (Legend of the Three Realms) despite the overlapping title. New characters set out from the South City Inn and choose from six unusually fantasy-flavored classes — swordsman, mage, terminator, elf, barbarian, or dark hell emissary — a broader genre mashup than the typical wuxia sect system. Registration sets up both an everyday login password and a separate recovery password, and the game has its own built-in anti-flood measures: a 60-second logout cooldown for regular accounts and rate-limiting on rapid reconnects.
sanjieshenhua.name: 三界神话 (San Jie Shen Hua) — 春节版

shenmo.description: 属于"ES II / Neolith"引擎家族（与本项目中的神州、随缘洗剑录等同宗），是一个从 1994 年一路开发维护到 2013 年的长寿老牌 MUD，多位巫师先后参与过其代码。本项目转换过的体量最大的资料包之一（三万余个源码文件）。
shenmo.english_description: A long-lived ES II/Neolith-engine game — sharing its engine lineage with sibling games shenzhou and Suiyuan Sword Legend in this collection — developed and maintained continuously from 1994 to 2013 by a long succession of wizards, and one of the largest archives in this collection at over 30,000 source files. Characters choose to be human, immortal, or demon before setting out from the South City Inn in Chang'an on a Journey-to-the-West-themed adventure through the demons and deities encountered along Tang Sanzang's pilgrimage route, built on the classic wuxia/xianxia progression of stats, sects, and martial cultivation. The South Sea Guanyin's Mount Putuo order even carries a persistent 'head disciple' title that naturally passes between characters as the game is played over time.
shenmo.english_name: Gods and Demons: Legend of the Journey West (shenmo)
shenmo.name: 神魔（西游记之神魔传说）

shenzhou.description: 自我介绍为**【神州】**（"Divine Land"），站点由"神州开发公会"运营，属于"ES II"引擎家族（与本项目中的随缘洗剑录、天下无雪等同宗），是一个经过多代维护者接力开发的老牌中文武侠 MUD。
shenzhou.english_description: A veteran Chinese wuxia mudlib self-styled 'Divine Land,' run by the Shenzhou Development Guild and built on the ES II engine family shared with sibling games Suiyuan Sword Legend and Heaven Without Snow in this collection, maintained across several generations of developers. New characters start out at the 'Hall of Novices' to get their bearings before formally entering the jianghu, with long-term systems for offline training, guilds, and a dedicated blacksmith profession rounding out a classic stats/sects/martial-cultivation core.
shenzhou.name: 神州

shiji.description: 自称 **世纪（CENTURY）**，登录 banner 的版权信息写着"星战英雄之乱世风沙"，采用 `adm/single/{master,simul_efun}` 布局，与本项目中若干"世纪家族"（Century）系列的姊妹站点同宗同源。
shiji.english_description: Self-titled "Century" (rendered as CENTURY in the login banner's copyright notice, which carries the tagline "Star Wars Heroes in a World of Chaos and Dust"). Built on the adm/single/{master,simul_efun} layout, it shares a common lineage with several sibling "Century family" sites elsewhere in this archive.
shiji.name: 世纪

shujian2008.description: 2008 年版本，由 ShuJian MUD 开发组制作，站点归属重庆电信。与同名的`sjtx2`（小熊泥苑分站）源码几乎完全一致，属于同一游戏在不同站点的两个部署。
shujian2008.english_description: A 2008 build made by the ShuJian MUD development team and hosted by Chongqing Telecom. Its source is nearly identical to the similarly named sjtx2 (Little Bear branch) elsewhere in this archive — two independent deployments of the same game on different sites.
shujian2008.name: 书剑天下 2008

shujian3.archive: 最新独立安卓客户端和书剑源码一键架站.zip
shujian3.description: 从一个嵌套压缩包中提取（外层压缩包同时打包了一个 Android 客户端 apk和这份 `shujian3.zip` 源码）；和 bxsj/bxsj1 及其他任何一个已有 lib 都没有 master-hash 匹配。原生启动干净，零修复，但 WASM 下的完整注册→游戏→退出流程需要下面这些真正的修复。
shujian3.english_description: Extracted from a nested archive that also bundled an Android client APK alongside this source tree. Despite the shared "Book and Sword" branding, it shares no code lineage with bxsj/bxsj1 or any other library in this collection — an entirely independent codebase, richer than a simple sect-and-map layout thanks to instanced dungeon content plus dedicated music and guild areas.
shujian3.name: 书剑3

shzs.description: 源自 archives/山海战神.rar。本作是在史巴克 (Spock) 开发的英文科幻引擎"Final Frontier v0.6e" 基础上二次改造而成的中文版本——属于 `simple`/ES II 引擎系列（本项目转换的第一个、也是最"标准"的一个样板库，后续绝大多数修复经验都是从它身上总结出来的）。
shzs.english_description: A Chinese-language adaptation of Spock's English-language science-fiction engine "Final Frontier v0.6e," part of the simple/ES II engine family. It was the very first library converted for this project, and the template most of the project's later restoration fixes were worked out on. Despite the wuxia-sounding name, it's not a martial-arts MUD but a hard-sci-fi combat simulator, with stats like Strength, Agility, and Technique and mecha- and laser-flavored battles.
shzs.english_name: War God of Mountains and Seas
shzs.name: 山海战神

sj.description: "战国"（Warring States）系代码库，`adm/obj/master.lpc` 一支——虽然slug 和 `sje`/`sjecl`（书剑系列）相似，但其实是完全不同的Century/adm-single 家族，不要混淆。
sj.english_description: A member of the "Warring States" codebase family (an adm/obj/master.lpc branch) — despite a slug resembling sje/sjecl (the "Book and Sword" series) elsewhere in this archive, it's an entirely unrelated lineage from those Century/adm-single titles. Its setting is science-fiction interstellar war rather than traditional wuxia: new characters start in the Tianlang star sector, buy starships at the spaceport, and align with one of four rival factions, with even wizard rank displayed under the in-universe title "Galaxy Special Police."
sj.name: 世纪 (sj)

sjcs.description: 以中国古典神话"三界"（天界/人间/地府）为背景的江湖世界。与本项目中同样带"三界"招牌的 `sanjieshenhua` 只是名字相似，经逐文件比对确认并非同一份代码（`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc` 均差异显著）。
sjcs.english_description: A jianghu world set against the backdrop of the classical Chinese cosmology of the "Three Realms" — Heaven, the Mortal World, and the Underworld. It shares only a name with the similarly titled sanjieshenhua elsewhere in this archive; file-by-file comparison of their master.lpc, securityd.lpc, and logind.lpc confirms the two are unrelated codebases.
sjcs.name: 三界传说 (San Jie Chuan Shuo)

sje.description: 和 096（`sjecl`，书剑恩仇录）同属 Century/adm-single 引擎家族（`adm/single/master.lpc` + `adm/daemons/securityd.lpc`），湖北电信的"书剑贰"泥潭，Ver2.1。
sje.english_description: A Hubei Telecom "Book and Sword II" MUD, version 2.1, belonging to the same Century/adm-single engine family (adm/single/master.lpc plus adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) as sjecl (The Book and the Sword) elsewhere in this archive.
sje.name: 书剑贰 (sje)

sjecl.description: Century/adm-single 引擎家族的一支（`adm/single/master.lpc` +`adm/daemons/securityd.lpc`，与 `sje`/`sjplgfjxb`/`sjplii` 等"书剑"系列泥潭同源），以金庸小说《书剑恩仇录》为背景的重庆电信"书剑"泥潭。WASM 阶段的"注册/look/score/quit 都干净"结论具有误导性——深度功能测试（§10.7）发现注册完成后**任何玩家指令都会返回"什么？"，游戏事实上完全无法操作**，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节。
sjecl.english_description: A Chongqing Telecom "Book and Sword" MUD based on Jin Yong's novel of the same name (published in English as The Book and the Sword), part of the Century/adm-single engine family (adm/single/master.lpc plus adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) shared with sje, sjplgfjxb, and sjplii elsewhere in this archive.
sjecl.name: 书剑恩仇录 (sjecl)

sjpl2.description: 自称 **【书剑飘零Ⅱ】**，英文名 "Stray Book & Sword"，由"飞白工作室"制作。虽然名字里同样带"书剑"二字，但与 `shujian2008`/`sjtx2`是完全不同、互不相关的两套代码。
sjpl2.english_description: Self-titled "Stray Book & Sword," made by Feibai Studio. Despite sharing the words "Book and Sword" in its name, it is a completely separate, unrelated codebase from shujian2008 and sjtx2 elsewhere in this archive.
sjpl2.name: 书剑飘零Ⅱ

sjplgfjxb.description: ES II 引擎家族（`adm/obj/master.lpc`，"original from Lil, rewritten byAnnihilator"），飞白工作室出品的《书剑飘零》官方教学版，与同门`sjplii`（书剑飘零II）同源；虽然名字里也带"书剑"，但和 Century/adm-single 家族的 `sjecl`/`sje` 属于完全不同的引擎谱系，纯属巧合。
sjplgfjxb.english_description: The official tutorial edition of Feibai Studio's Stray Book and Sword, built on the ES II engine family (adm/obj/master.lpc, "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator") and sharing its codebase with sibling title sjplii (Stray Book and Sword II). Despite also carrying the words "Book and Sword," it belongs to an entirely different engine lineage from the Century/adm-single family's sjecl and sje — a naming coincidence, nothing more.
sjplgfjxb.english_name: Stray Book and Sword: Official Tutorial Edition
sjplgfjxb.name: 书剑飘零官方教学版 (sjplgfjxb)

sjplii.description: 和 097（`sjplgfjxb`，书剑飘零官方教学版）同属飞白工作室的《书剑飘零》ES II 引擎家族，这份档案用的是 `adm/daemons/securityd.lpc`（没有 097 那种 `securd`/`securityd` 双档案混淆的问题）。
sjplii.english_description: Another Feibai Studio "Stray Book and Sword" title on the ES II engine, sibling to sjplgfjxb (the Official Tutorial Edition), but using a single, unambiguous adm/daemons/securityd.lpc rather than its sibling's confusing dual securd/securityd setup.
sjplii.name: 书剑飘零II (sjplii)

sjsh.archive: 三界神话（宝鸡站的版本）.rar
sjsh.description: "三界神话"系列（San Jie Shen Hua）宝鸡站版本，五个同系档案中的第一个（另外四个：`sjshv150`/`sjshv2578bb`/`sjshwzb`/`sjshwzjqb`）。
sjsh.english_description: The original Baoji-station build of the "Myth of the Three Realms" (San Jie Shen Hua) series — the first of five related codebases in this archive, the other four being sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, sjshwzb, and sjshwzjqb.
sjsh.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Baoji Station)
sjsh.name: 三界神话『宝鸡站』(sjsh)

sjshv150.description: "三界神话"系列第二个档案（另见 099 `sjsh`/宝鸡站），紫藤分站的内容，和宝鸡站不完全一样，但核心代码库同源。
sjshv150.english_description: The second build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original) — content for the Wisteria branch server, which differs somewhat from the Baoji station but shares the same core codebase. Kaifeng city is a substantial standalone puzzle-quest zone later reused by the "Chutian" server, and the game's own included notes candidly admit it "still has bugs galore, including one known (minor) backdoor."
sjshv150.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Wisteria Branch)
sjshv150.name: 三界神话「紫藤分站」(sjshv150)

sjshv2578bb.description: "三界神话"系列第三个档案（另见 099 `sjsh`/宝鸡站、100 `sjshv150`/紫藤分站），测试二区的内容。这份档案的 `sited.lpc` 本来就无条件允许本地回环地址连线（没有 `sjshv150` 那种"仅限巫师"的限制）。
sjshv2578bb.english_description: The third build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original, and sjshv150, the Wisteria branch) — content for a "Test Zone 2" server. Unlike its Wisteria-branch sibling, this build's site daemon allows local loopback connections unconditionally, giving it a smoother out-of-the-box registration experience.
sjshv2578bb.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Test Zone 2)
sjshv2578bb.name: 三界神话「测试二区」(sjshv2578bb)

sjshwzb.description: "三界神话"系列第四个档案（另见 099 `sjsh`/宝鸡站、100 `sjshv150`/紫藤分站、101 `sjshv2578bb`/测试二区），泉州师范专科学院站点的完整版内容。这份档案的核心文件（`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc`）和前三个档案并非完全同源：`master.lpc` 的`log_error()`/`standard_trace()` 根本没有呼叫 `CHANNEL_D`，所以§7.60 那个死锁在这里不存在；`securityd.lpc` 的 `valid_read()` 也没有覆盖 `user` 参数的问题；这份档案也没有 `sited.lpc`，不存在本地回环限制。
sjshwzb.english_description: The fourth build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, and sjshv2578bb) — the complete edition run by the Quanzhou Normal College site. Unlike its three siblings, its core system files (master.lpc, securityd.lpc, logind.lpc) represent a genuine code fork rather than a mere content variant, and it's the most content-rich entry in the family, with exclusive areas drawing on Buddhist and mythological concepts such as Asura, the Demon Realm, and the Sky Realm.
sjshwzb.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
sjshwzb.name: 三界神话完整版「泉州师院」(sjshwzb)

sjshwzjqb.description: "三界神话"系列第五个、也是最后一个档案（另见 099 `sjsh`/宝鸡站、100 `sjshv150`/紫藤分站、101 `sjshv2578bb`/测试二区、102 `sjshwzb`/泉州师院完整版），和 102 `sjshwzb` 同源，核心文件（`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc`）与已知 bug 集合完全一致：`master.lpc` 的 `log_error()`/`standard_trace()` 没有呼叫`CHANNEL_D`（§7.60 不适用），`securityd.lpc` 的 `valid_read()` 不会覆盖 `user` 参数，也没有 `sited.lpc`（不存在本地回环限制）。
sjshwzjqb.english_description: The fifth and final build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, and sjshwzb) — an enhanced edition sharing sjshwzb's Quanzhou map and core system files almost exactly, differing mainly in operational details such as starting with an empty wizard list rather than a pre-seeded one.
sjshwzjqb.english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Enhanced Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
sjshwzjqb.name: 三界神话完整加强版「泉州师院」(sjshwzjqb)

sjtx2.description: 同样自称**「书剑天下」**，这是"小熊泥苑"（http://dtxy.126.com）站点部署的一个分支——与本项目中的 `shujian2008` 源码几乎完全一致（同一款游戏，不同站点的两次独立部署）。
sjtx2.english_description: Self-titled "Book and Sword Under Heaven," like shujian2008, this is a branch deployed by the "Little Bear Mud Garden" (dtxy.126.com) site. Its source is nearly identical to shujian2008's — two independent deployments of the same game on different servers.
sjtx2.english_name: Book and Sword Under Heaven (Little Bear Branch)
sjtx2.name: 书剑天下（小熊泥苑分站）

syxjl.description: 自称 **【随缘洗剑录】**，是"ES II"引擎家族的一员（与本项目中的神州、火影、武汉站等同宗），由 Annihilator 等人在原始 ES II 基础上多次改写而成，是一款有较长运营历史的老牌武侠 MUD。
syxjl.english_description: Self-titled "Sui Yuan Xi Jian Lu" (roughly, "the chronicle of washing one's sword as fate wills"), a member of the ES II engine family — kin to this archive's Shenzhou, Huoying, and Wuhan-station titles — repeatedly rewritten from the original ES II base by Annihilator and others. It's a long-running, well-established wuxia MUD.
syxjl.english_name: Sui Yuan Xi Jian Lu (Sword Washed by Fate)
syxjl.name: 随缘洗剑录

tianxia.description: 自称 **《天下》Beta**，作者署名"发现号（Find@tx）"，与本项目中的"泥潭"（nitan）系列师出同门（同一作者），但代码库本身是完全独立的一套。
tianxia.english_description: Self-titled "Tianxia (World Under Heaven) Beta," credited to an author known as "Discovery No. (Find@tx)" — from the same author as this archive's "Nitan" series, though built on a completely independent codebase.
tianxia.name: 天下 Beta

tianxiawuxue.description: 自称 **天下无雪**（"A World Without Snow"），作者署名"Dream"，鸣谢名单包括 Poor、Sinb、Lonely、Zjb 等多位巫师，是一个运营较久、拥有独立世界观的中文武侠 MUD。地图其实和"天涯"家族同源——`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）与 `xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy` 等同样打着"夕阳再现"或其它品牌、实际却是"天涯"血统的档案逐字节相同（本档案新角色随机落在的"北疆小镇""铁枪庙"等起点也和那几份档案完全对应），此前没有任何一份档案互相记录过这层关系；鸣谢名单里的"Lonely"正是NT/nitan 系的作者，说明这个更大的生态圈之间本来就存在人员/代码交流。
tianxiawuxue.english_description: Self-titled "A World Without Snow," credited to an author known as "Dream" with an acknowledgments list naming several fellow wizards (Poor, Sinb, Lonely, Zjb, among others) — a long-running Chinese wuxia MUD with its own distinct setting. Its map, however, turns out to share deep roots with this archive's "Tianya" (Horizon) lineage: several scenes, including its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump location, are byte-for-byte identical to areas in other differently-branded games in that lineage — a connection no prior entry in this archive had documented before. One of its credited wizards, "Lonely," is also the author of the Nitan series, hinting at genuine code and personnel exchange across this wider MUD community.
tianxiawuxue.name: 天下无雪

tiexuejianghu.description: 属于 ES II（Eastern Stories II）引擎系列武侠 mudlib，与本项目中的wuhanzhan《大话西游》、wmkj《未明空间》等同属一个大家族，但代码库本身是独立分支。
tiexuejianghu.english_description: A wuxia mudlib built on the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine, part of the same family as this archive's Wuhanzhan (A Chinese Odyssey) and Weiming Kongjian, though it is an independently developed branch. Created by the author "hxsd," it centers on sect management and NPC recruitment, backed by an unusually complete merchant/trading subsystem the author likened to Uncharted Waters. New players start at the Hero's Tavern and can train in martial arts, roam the jianghu, and join a sect to earn income from its holdings. The original server closed after its popularity waned and its wizard staff fell into internal conflict, after which the author released the source code — this archive preserves that release.
tiexuejianghu.english_name: Tie Xue Jiang Hu (Blood and Iron Jianghu)
tiexuejianghu.name: 铁血江湖 (Tie Xue Jiang Hu)

tybxjh.description: 天涯泥潭（Tianya MUD Wizard Group）的"碧血江湖"档案，自 2002 年建站运行至今的老牌武侠 MUD。这份档案在 WASM 下**编译/登录流程本身无需修复**——没有编译错误，没有执行时段错误，整个登录/注册流程一次跑通；但深度功能测试（§10.7）发现了好几个真实存在的程序 bug，包括一个从建站至今就存在的严重安全问题，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节。同一个"天涯"代码家族还有 `wlhd`（武林浩荡/金庸梦II，`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc` 核心系统档案结构几乎一致，但地图内容各自独立修改过）、`xhcii`（笑红尘Ⅱ）、`zxty`（再现天涯）、`ffxymud`（非凡夕阳MUD/时空游侠录）、`jhfy2`（江湖风云2）、`xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）、`xyzxiiylzymh`（夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端）和 `yzxiiizylfy`（夕阳再现III之炎龙封印）——后三者标题都带"夕阳再现"但地图其实是这个家族（真正的"夕阳再现"血统是`xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 那一支完全不同的代码）。除 `wlhd`/`yxjh` 外，这七者的 `d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）逐字节完全相同；`wlhd`/`yxjh` 用的是 `wlhd` 独立改写过的"jump"版本，`ffxymud`/`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy` 连登入横幅/标题都完全不像同一批档案，如果不比对源码很难发现它们同源。
tybxjh.english_description: The Tianya MUD Wizard Group's "Bi Xue Jiang Hu" (Jianghu of Sworn Blood) archive, a long-running wuxia MUD that has operated since 2002. The archive compiled and booted cleanly under WASM with no fixes needed, but deeper functional testing turned up several real, previously unknown bugs, including a serious security flaw dating back to the game's founding. It belongs to the same "Tianya" codebase family as several other archives in this collection (including wlhd and xhcii), sharing near-identical core systems even where each site's map content was customized independently.
tybxjh.english_name: Bi Xue Jiang Hu — Tianya Edition
tybxjh.name: 天涯之碧血江湖 (tybxjh)

wdxtym.description: 这份档案对应一次原本超时中断的转档（46890 个文件的大档案）。它用的是一套**自定义客户端协议**，不是普通的逐行提示：服务器一连线就送出一行版本挑战 `ver1.0,<crypt-salt>`，客户端必须回传正确加密后的应答，或者两个内建的绕过字符串之一（测试用 `123456789abcd` 即可），否则直接显示"客户端非法"并断线。之后的账号注册/角色创建也是整行、用全角竖线 `║` 分隔多个字段一次送出（`账号║密码║密文║email`，角色创建则是 `性别║头像║昵称`），这是为配合专属 GUI 客户端设计的协议，不是 bug。
wdxtym.english_description: A large, 46,890-file archive whose conversion originally timed out mid-transfer. It uses a custom client protocol rather than a plain-text telnet prompt: on connecting, the server issues a version challenge that the client must answer with a correctly encrypted response (or one of two built-in bypass strings), or be disconnected as an "illegal client." Account registration and character creation likewise arrive as single lines with multiple fields separated by a full-width vertical bar (║) — a design built for the game's dedicated GUI client, not a bug.
wdxtym.english_name: Wu Dong Xian Tu (Martial Path to Immortality)
wdxtym.name: 武动仙途 (wdxtym)

wlhd.description: 游戏内品牌为《金庸梦II》/《武林浩荡》。这份档案和 104 `tybxjh`（天涯之碧血江湖）明显是同源代码——`master.lpc`/`securityd.lpc`/`logind.lpc` 结构几乎一致，注册提示文字相同，`wiz_levels` 权限阶梯一样到 `(ceo)` 为止，`globals.h` 里连"决定用哪个 `SECURITY_D`"的注释掉的备用行都相同。同一个"天涯"代码家族还有 `xhcii`（笑红尘Ⅱ）、`zxty`（再现天涯）、`ffxymud`（非凡夕阳MUD，登入横幅完全不提"天涯"二字）、`jhfy2`（江湖风云2）、`xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）和 `xyzxiiylzymh`（夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端，后两者标题都带"夕阳再现"却和这个家族同源）；`yxjh`（浴血江湖）的地图和这份档案（`wlhd`）本身逐字节相同，用的正是这份档案独立改写过的"jump"版跳崖场景，不是 `tybxjh` 的原始版本。这几份档案的"世界之巅"跳崖场景（`d/city/sj.lpc`）逐字节相同；这份档案（`wlhd`）自己把同一个房间的玩法独立改写过（指令改成 `jump`，加了 `valid_leave()`），但核心系统档案的同源关系不受影响。
wlhd.english_description: Branded in-game as Jin Yong's Dream II / Wu Lin Hao Dang, this archive shares an evidently common codebase with this collection's tybxjh (Bi Xue Jiang Hu) — its master, security, and login daemons are nearly identical — and belongs to the same "Tianya" code family as several other archives here (xhcii, zxty, ffxymud, jhfy2, and others). It even rewrote one shared scene, the "Peak of the World" cliff-jump, with its own custom "jump" command — a variant later reused verbatim by this collection's yxjh.
wlhd.english_name: Wu Lin Hao Dang (Jin Yong's Dream II)
wlhd.name: 武林浩荡 (wlhd)

wmkj.description: 原始压缩包自称"未明空间"，但实际连接后显示的游戏名是**"江湖风云之夕阳再现"**——这是"夕阳再现"（Sunset Reappears）引擎系列的一个分支版本，与本项目中的 xyzxfk、jhfy 等同源，但 master/登录/安全模块各自独立开发，并非简单换皮。这一支和另一轮处理过的 `xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
wmkj.english_description: The archive is labeled "Weiming Kongjian," but once connected the game actually identifies itself as "Jianghu Fengyun: Sunset Reappears" — a branch of the "Sunset Reappears" (Xi Yang Zai Xian) engine family that shares lineage with this collection's xyzxfk and jhfy, though each was developed independently rather than being a simple reskin. It belongs to the true "Sunset Reappears" bloodline alongside this collection's xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412 — notably distinct from another group of archives here that carry the same brand name but actually descend from an unrelated "Tianya" codebase, a reminder that branding alone doesn't indicate lineage.
wmkj.name: 未明空间 (Weiming Kongjian / "wmkj")

wqfy.description: 郑州风云世纪珍藏版，游戏内横幅显示为《天下无敌》，以古龙小说为背景的武侠 MUD。这份档案在 WASM 下**完全无需修复**——没有编译错误，没有执行时段错误，整个注册流程一次跑通。和 `zzfy3`（郑州风云3，同样打着"天下无敌"横幅）是同一套代码库——`d/marry/hongniang-zhang.lpc` 逐字节相同，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。
wqfy.english_description: The Zhengzhou Fengyun "Collector's Edition," branded in-game as "Invincible Under Heaven," is a wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels rather than the more common Jin Yong universe, with sect and faction names to match. It required no fixes at all to run cleanly under WASM. It shares an identical codebase with this collection's zzfy3 (Zhengzhou Fengyun 3) — a relationship not previously documented between the two archives.
wqfy.english_name: Wu Qing Feng Yun (Invincible Under Heaven)
wqfy.name: 无情风云 (wqfy)

wuhanzhan.description: 原始压缩包名为"武汉站"，但这只是收藏者标注的站点标签——游戏自身的config 与登录横幅都写明真正的名字是**"大话西游"**，由湖北楚天热线旗下的襄樊分站运营。属于 ES II（Eastern Stories II）引擎系列，与本项目中的 wmkj、tiexuejianghu 等同宗但各自独立开发。
wuhanzhan.english_description: The original archive was labeled "Wuhan Station," but that's just a collector's site tag — the game's own config and login banner identify its true name as A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You), themed after the beloved Stephen Chow film, and run by the Xiangfan branch of Hubei's Chutian Hotline network. It belongs to the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine family, sharing lineage with this collection's wmkj and tiexuejianghu, though each was developed independently.
wuhanzhan.english_name: A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You)
wuhanzhan.name: 大话西游 (A Chinese Odyssey)

wxddym.description: 一款以「世外桃源」为起点的武侠 MUD，采用非标准的移动端客户端协议（非纯文字 telnet 提示语）。
wxddym.english_description: A wuxia MUD that begins in the "Peach Blossom Spring," a legendary hidden utopia, built around a non-standard mobile-client protocol rather than plain-text telnet prompts. New characters must complete an elaborate, multi-step "rebirth" ritual — allocating attribute points, rerolling aptitudes, choosing a temperament, and picking one of seven ancestral clans — before they truly enter the world.
wxddym.english_name: Wu Xue Da Dao (The Great Way of Martial Arts)
wxddym.name: 武学大道

xajdxyj.description: "神话世界·西游记"4.50 版，游戏内品牌为《欢乐园》("A Journey to theWest"，大学生版)，西安交大兵马俑 BBS 附属的 MUD。
xajdxyj.english_description: Version 4.50 of "Mythical World: Journey to the West," branded in-game as Huanle Yuan ("Garden of Joy," subtitled "A Journey to the West, College Edition") — a MUD affiliated with the Terracotta Warriors BBS at Xi'an Jiaotong University.
xajdxyj.english_name: Xi'an Jiaotong University Journey to the West (Huanle Yuan)
xajdxyj.name: 西安交大西游记 (xajdxyj)

xajh2.description: 游戏登录画面自称"虚拟人生"。属于"XO mudlib"引擎家族（源自 TMI-2 /ES2，由 Falcon 于1996年重写），与本项目另收录的《笑傲江湖迷你版》《XO最终版1.2》同源但是独立的、更晚的一个站点快照（站内公告显示自2003年4月1日开站）。
xajh2.english_description: The login screen calls this game "Virtual Life." It belongs to the "XO mudlib" engine family (descended from TMI-2/ES2, rewritten by "Falcon" in 1996), sharing lineage with this collection's Xiao Ao Jiang Hu Mini Edition and XO Final 1.2, but is an independent, later snapshot of the game — in-game notices show it opened on April 1, 2003.
xajh2.english_name: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer II (Xiao Ao Jiang Hu II)
xajh2.name: 笑傲江湖 II

xajh4gkb.description: 游戏内品牌为「夕阳再现」之「笑傲江湖Ⅳ」，作者阿飞在"炎龙"内核基础上修改的第四代版本。这份档案在 WASM 下**完全无需修复**——没有编译错误，没有执行时段错误，整个注册流程一次跑通。`jhfy3`（江湖风云3，同样打着"夕阳再现"旗号）和 `xyzx`（夕阳再现，同一品牌的源头版本之一）的"世界之巅"跳崖场景（`d/city/sj.lpc`）都和这份档案逐字节相同，是同一个"夕阳再现"代码血统的成员——注意打着相同"夕阳再现"品牌的 `xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh` 反而是完全不同的"天涯"家族地图，品牌名称不能作为血统依据。深度功能测试（§10.7）确认没有代码逻辑 bug，但发现普通移动就会反复触发资源限制中断，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节。
xajh4gkb.english_description: Branded in-game as "Sunset Reappears: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer IV," this is the fourth-generation version author Afei built atop the "Yanlong" engine core. It required no fixes to run cleanly under WASM. It shares byte-identical scenes with this collection's jhfy3 and xyzx, both also carrying the "Sunset Reappears" brand, making it a genuine member of that lineage — unlike another group of archives that use the same brand name but actually descend from the unrelated "Tianya" codebase.
xajh4gkb.english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu IV — Public Edition (Sunset Reappears)
xajh4gkb.name: 笑傲江湖4公开版 (xajh4gkb)

xajhxo.description: 游戏取材自金庸小说《笑傲江湖》，"XO"是这个版本自己的代号（登录横幅上写着"THE SMILING PROUD WANDERER"）。它源自"TMI-2/ES2"引擎，由"Falcon"改写，本项目里另外两个库 `xo`（笑傲江湖迷你版）和 `xo_final`（XO 最终版1.2）都是同一血脉的不同快照，这一份是三者中独立演化出来的第三个版本。
xajhxo.english_description: Based on Jin Yong's novel The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, "XO" is this version's own codename (the login banner reads "THE SMILING PROUD WANDERER"), descended from the TMI-2/ES2 engine lineage and rewritten by "Falcon." This collection also holds two other snapshots of the same bloodline, xo (Mini Edition) and xo_final (Final 1.2); this archive is the third, independently evolved branch of the three.
xajhxo.english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu XO (The Smiling, Proud Wanderer)
xajhxo.name: 笑傲江湖 XO

xajhzcjh.archive: 笑傲江湖服务端+客户端.rar
xajhzcjh.description: 作者 AKAI，脱胎自"夕阳再现－江湖风云2－风云再起"引擎（属于"夕阳再现/XYZX"系列衍生分支，与本项目收录的多部同系列作品——如《侠客风云》《西阳再现疯狂版》等——师出同门，但游戏内容各自独立开发）。archive名称中的"服务端+客户端"其实指的是同一套游戏支持两种连线协议（普通telnet 客户端 和 TOMUD 菜单客户端），并不是额外附带了一个独立的客户端程序。
xajhzcjh.english_description: By author AKAI, this game grew out of the "Sunset Reappears — Jianghu Fengyun 2 — Storm Rising Again" engine lineage, a branch of the broader Sunset Reappears/XYZX family shared with other archives in this collection, though its content was developed independently. The archive name's "server + client" actually refers to support for two connection protocols on the same game — plain telnet and a TOMUD menu client — not a bundled standalone client program.
xajhzcjh.english_name: Xiao Ao Jiang Hu: Return to the Jianghu
xajhzcjh.name: 笑傲江湖之重出江湖

xbtxiii.description: 真正的 1997-2001 年代 mudlib（按其自带 readme 所述），一个"风云"衍生分支。原始归档以 4 个分卷 zip（XB.ZIP.1-4）形式提供，解开后内层是12 个按目录拆分的 tar.gz，而非扁平目录树。
xbtxiii.english_description: A genuine 1997-2001-era mudlib by its own internal readme, descended from the "Fengyun" lineage. The original archive shipped as four split zip volumes containing twelve directory-by-directory tar.gz files rather than a flat directory tree. Character creation blends Western MUD-style classes (a choice between enchanter and fighter) with a wuxia setting, and death leads into an unusually elaborate five-stage ghost journey narrated by the deity Bai Wuchang.
xbtxiii.english_name: Xiong Ba Tian Xia III (Lord of the World III)
xbtxiii.name: 雄霸天下III

xfbhh.description: NT/泥潭（nitan）血统，与 `hhsj`（洪荒世界原版）和 `nitan170911` 共享byte-identical 的 master 文件。新角色从「泥潭注册室」开始。
xfbhh.english_description: Part of the "Nitan" (NT) mudlib lineage, sharing a byte-identical master codebase with this collection's hhsj (the original Honghuang World) and nitan170911.
