New characters begin in the "Nitan Registration Hall" and must complete an elaborate, multi-step "birth" ritual — choosing a race, gender, and temperament, then allocating attribute points in the "Valley of Life" — before truly entering the world.
xfbhh.english_name: Honghuang World — Fixed Edition (World of Primordial Chaos)
xfbhh.name: 洪荒世界（修复版）

xhcii.description: 笑红尘②，拓勘资讯组（topkan.com）开发。地图（华山、武当、峨嵋、丐帮、明教、大理、荆州等）和"世界之巅"跳崖场景与 104 `tybxjh`/`wlhd` 高度一致（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐行核对确认是同一段代码的不同转码版本），应属同一批"天涯"系家族的又一分支（`zxty`/再现天涯、`ffxymud`/非凡夕阳MUD、`jhfy2`/江湖风云2、`xysylmhb`/夕阳三-炎龙美化版、`xyzxiiylzymh`/夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端 也是同一家族，`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同），此前的 AGENTS.md 里未记录这层关系。WASM 修复阶段曾误判"完全无需修复"，深度功能测试（§10.7）纠正了这个结论——真正的核心发现见下方"深度功能测试"一节。
xhcii.english_description: Developed by Topkan Information Group (topkan.com), Xiao Hong Chen II shares its map — sects and cities including Huashan, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, Dali, and Jingzhou — and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene almost verbatim with this collection's tybxjh and wlhd, marking it as another branch of the same "Tianya" code family. WASM testing initially judged the archive fully working, but deeper functional testing later corrected that assessment and uncovered real, previously undocumented bugs.
xhcii.english_name: Xiao Hong Chen II (Laughing at the Red Dust II)
xhcii.name: 笑红尘Ⅱ (xhcii)

xiakexing100.description: 取材自金庸小说《侠客行》，作者 "Coollizard" 与 "xkx100" 团队自 2001 年起维护，属于本项目中"Century 家族"（`adm/single/` 目录结构）武侠mudlib 分支之一，是这批游戏中文件数量最多的一个（转换后约 1.2 万个LPC 文件）。
xiakexing100.english_description: Based on Jin Yong's novel Ode to Gallantry (Xia Ke Xing), developed since 2001 by author Coollizard and the xkx100 team. It belongs to this collection's "Century" mudlib family (built around an adm/single/ directory layout) and is the largest of that group by file count — roughly 12,000 LPC files after conversion. Its map is built around real historical Chinese cities, including Beijing, Chang'an, Luoyang, and Yangzhou, with new characters starting at a randomly assigned home-city inn.
xiakexing100.english_name: Xia Ke Xing 100 (Ode to Gallantry — Centennial Edition)
xiakexing100.name: 侠客行一百 (Xia Ke Xing - Yi Bai)

xiakexing2017.description: 取材自金庸小说《侠客行》，压缩包标注为"2017完整版"，与本项目中的xiakexing100、xiakexing3 属于名字相近但代码库彼此独立的不同分支（各自的核心引擎文件并不相同）。
xiakexing2017.english_description: Based on Jin Yong's novel Ode to Gallantry (Xia Ke Xing), this archive is labeled the "2017 Complete Edition." It shares its name with this collection's xiakexing100 and xiakexing3, but its codebase is entirely independent — the core engine files differ across all three. New characters start at an inn and can train in martial arts, meet fellow wanderers, and join the major sects, while the game clock displays "Xia Ke Xing time," real Beijing time, and the lunar calendar side by side.
xiakexing2017.english_name: Xia Ke Xing — 2017 Complete Edition (Ode to Gallantry)
xiakexing2017.name: 侠客行 (MUD侠客行2017完整版)

xiakexing3.description: 压缩包与内部配置文件都叫"侠客行三"，但实际连接进游戏后，登录横幅显示的名字是**"金庸群侠传"**——经比对，这份存档与本项目中的jqxz2008 系列共享同一套 master 核心代码，是同一引擎不同时期的换皮/内容版本。**WASM 阶段"注册流程完整验证过、没有发现bug"的结论需要更正**：§10.7 深度功能测试发现新角色食物/饮水初始化判断的对象错了（§8.9，永远初始化成 0）、`get_name()` 有一行调试用的 `printf` 会把玩家对象引用泄漏给新玩家、以及全档案 18 个留言板实例都撞上了 §7.86 那个"多余 `replace_program()` 让 `post` 永久崩溃"的经典致命形状，均已修复并 live 验证，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节与 `NOTES.md`。
xiakexing3.english_description: Both the archive and its internal config call this game "Xia Ke Xing III," but the actual login banner reads "Heroes of Jin Yong" (Jin Yong Qun Xia Zhuan). It shares its core master codebase with this collection's jqxz2008 series — a different-era reskin and content version of the same engine. Deeper functional testing later corrected an overly optimistic early assessment, uncovering and fixing several real bugs, including a broken food/water initialization check and a crash affecting all 18 bulletin boards in the game.
xiakexing3.english_name: Heroes of Jin Yong (formerly Xia Ke Xing III)
xiakexing3.name: 金庸群侠传 (原名"侠客行三")

xianlvqiyuan.description: 又称 XLQY，2001年"知秋站"（www.mudfan.com）快照版本。属于"仙侣情缘"引擎家族，与本项目另收录的"浙大版"分支同源但代码更早、更接近原始版本。游戏内自称"西游传奇之仙侣情缘"（A Journey To The West / FairyLove Story）。
xianlvqiyuan.english_description: A 2001 snapshot from the "Zhiqiu" site (www.mudfan.com), part of the Fairy Love Story engine family and a sibling to this project's separately archived "Zhejiang University edition" branch, but with earlier code closer to the original. In-game it calls itself "A Journey to the West: Fairy Love Story." Players set out from an inn in southern Chang'an and cultivate through stages of the Tao, martial arts, and inner power toward a scripture-seeking, havoc-in-heaven-style story arc, with an overall casual pace.
xianlvqiyuan.name: 仙侣情缘（知秋站 2001版）

xiaoyuxiyou.description: 游戏自身配置里写的名字是《小雨西游》，但实际登录横幅打出来的是《小雨西游Ⅱ》（v3.0，2013 年建站），两者是同一套引擎在不同年份、不同站点的快照，内容基本一致。它与本项目另一个已转换的库`xyxy2`（20150716未知lib）同属一个引擎家族（`chinese.c`文件完全一致）。
xiaoyuxiyou.english_description: A Journey to the West-themed wuxia/xianxia MUD set around the Aolai Kingdom and Green Fragrance Tower, with characters, quests, and place names closely tied to the classic novel's mythology, emphasizing traditional scripture-seeking and demon-slaying character growth. It shares an identical chinese.c file with this project's xyxy2 lib, pointing to a common engine lineage, and also features a fairly complete clan system, celestial-realm announcements, and message boards.
xiaoyuxiyou.name: 小雨西游

xixingzhanji.description: 游戏自称《西行战记》，配置文件里写着"总站"，但实际登录横幅打的是"西行战记[宜昌站]"——这是同一套源码在不同地区搭建的分站，内容是一样的，只是站点名字没改而已。它属于 ES II（Eastern Stories II）架构的一个独立分支，和本项目里其他好几个西游/ES II 系 Mud 是远房同门。
xixingzhanji.english_description: A jianghu MUD set against the backdrop of Journey to the West, where new players start at the "South City Inn" in Chang'an and progress through scripture-seeking, demon-slaying, and sect trials. Part of an independent branch of the ES II (Eastern Stories II) architecture, distantly related to several other Journey to the West / ES II MUDs in this collection, it retains classic ES II staples such as message boards, talent-point allocation, and the four core attributes (physique, bone-root, comprehension, spirit), well suited to players who enjoy slow-paced text character progression.
xixingzhanji.name: 西行战记

xiyouji.description: 登录画面自称 *A Journey to the West*，版本号 2.01，最早制作于1996-1998 年。本项目考证认为它极可能是"ES II / 西游记"这一整个引擎家族（包括 `xyj2000f`、`mhxy`、`xiyouji2003`、`xiyouji2006`、`xiyouji450`、`shenmo` 等在内的众多同题材姊妹游戏）**最早的祖先版本**——文件时间戳最早，且没有任何后续站点加上的"破解者"署名痕迹。
xiyouji.english_description: Self-titled "A Journey to the West," version 2.01, originally created 1996-1998. This project's research concludes it is very likely the earliest ancestor of the entire "ES II / Journey to the West" engine family (which includes xyj2000f, mhxy, xiyouji2003, xiyouji2006, xiyouji450, shenmo, and other sibling games in this collection) — its files carry the earliest timestamps and show none of the "cracker" credit lines later sites added. Set in the world of the original novel, players set out from Chang'an to explore the story's iconic locations (the Silk-Web Cave, Five-Finger Mountain, the South Sea, and more). As the wellspring of the whole Journey to the West MUD lineage its world content is comparatively simple, the most primitive form in the series and a useful baseline for comparing how the later branches evolved.
xiyouji.name: 西游记 (A Journey to the West)

xiyouji2003.description: 一款 2003 年前后的"西游记"系列文字 MUD，与本项目中的`xyj2000f`、`xiyouji`、`xiyouji2006`、`xiyouji450`、`mhxy` 等同属"ES II / 西游记"这一大家族——它与 `xyj2000f` 的核心引擎代码（`master.c`）几乎完全一致，是这条支线中较晚、内容更丰富的一个独立站点。
xiyouji2003.english_description: A circa-2003 entry in the Journey to the West series of text MUDs, part of the same "ES II / Journey to the West" family as this project's xyj2000f, xiyouji, xiyouji2006, xiyouji450, and mhxy — its core engine code (master.c) is nearly identical to xyj2000f, making it a later, more content-rich offshoot of that branch. Players set out from the South City Inn in Chang'an to face "eighty-one trials" across the three realms of heaven, earth, and the underworld, backed by a fairly developed system of sects, guilds, warfare, marriage, and Five Elements attributes. The inn's message board still preserves genuine historical developer announcements — quest-system revision notes, bug-fix notices, sect leaderboard rules — a firsthand record of how the site was run at the time.
xiyouji2003.english_name: Journey to the West: Glory Days
xiyouji2003.name: 西游记[光辉岁月]

xiyouji2006.archive: 西游记2006之 最终幻想.rar
xiyouji2006.description: 存档里出现过三个不同的名字：压缩包标题叫"最终幻想"，游戏登录横幅自称"西游记2006 之 最后的疯狂"，游戏内公告则说已正式更名为**《大唐西游》**。属于 mhxy/梦幻西游 一支"西游记"引擎家族——与本项目中的 `mhxy`、`shenmo`（西游记之神魔传说）同源，但由不同站点独立开发维护多年，内容已大幅分化。
xiyouji2006.english_description: Its saved files carry three different names: the archive is labeled "Final Fantasy," the login banner announces itself as "Journey to the West 2006: The Final Madness," and in-game notices declare it formally renamed to Great Tang Journey West. Part of the mhxy/Dream of Journey to the West engine family, sharing common ancestry with this project's mhxy and shenmo (Journey to the West: Legend of Gods and Demons) but independently developed and maintained by a different site for years, with substantially diverged content. Players alternate between growing as an ordinary mortal (apprenticing under a master, building a life) and following two signature storylines, "the journey west" and "havoc in heaven," with leaderboards for wealth, kills, and cultivation, and the Tang Monk and his disciples wandering the map as background NPCs to reinforce the atmosphere.
xiyouji2006.english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Great Tang Pilgrimage
xiyouji2006.name: 西游记2006·大唐西游

xiyouji450.description: 这是一份专门用于建立"镜像站"的发行包，内附教学说明，供其他站长在其基础上另开一个分身站点。与本项目中的 `xyj2000f`、`mhxy`、`mhxyqd` 同属一支血缘极近的"西游记/xiyouji.org"引擎家族——核心引擎文件（`master.c`、`chinese.c` 等）与 `mhxy` 几乎逐字一致，只有站点自定义的登录/安全层与世界内容各自不同。
xiyouji450.english_description: A distribution package built specifically for setting up "mirror sites," complete with a tutorial for other site operators to launch their own branch on top of it. It belongs to the same closely related "Journey to the West / xiyouji.org" engine family as this project's xyj2000f, mhxy, and mhxyqd — its core engine files (master.c, chinese.c, and others) are nearly word-for-word identical to mhxy, differing only in the site's own login/security layer and world content. Set in the Journey to the West universe, players start at the South City Inn in Chang'an and explore the three realms while practicing martial arts and joining sects; as a mirror-site package its world closely resembles the xyj2000f/mhxy line but runs its own independent registration and security system.
xiyouji450.name: 西游记450

xjcq2000.description: 作者叶雨飞。属于"Century（世纪）家族"武侠 MUD 引擎（与《书剑2008》《书剑飘零II》等同源，管理层目录结构相似），但游戏内容和安全模块均为独立开发，并非简单复制。
xjcq2000.english_description: By author Ye Yufei. Part of the "Century" family of wuxia MUD engines (sharing lineage with Book and Sword 2008 and Book and Sword: Adrift II, with similar admin directory structures), though its game content and security modules were independently developed rather than copied. Set in a traditional wuxia world centered on Yangzhou — its central square, shops, the provincial governor's office, and major sects (the Beggars' Sect, Quanzhen Sect, White Camel Mountain, the Five Poisons Sect, the Sun Moon Holy Cult, and more). Distinctive "banditry" and "armed escort" job systems add flavor to jianghu life, all in an orthodox Jin Yong/Gu Long-style wuxia atmosphere well suited to players who enjoy sect progression and quest systems.
xjcq2000.english_name: Immortal Sword Wandering Knight 2000 (Legend of the Sword)
xjcq2000.name: 仙剑狂侠2000（仙剑传奇）

xkm.description: 与 147/jym（金庸梦）同源代码线（同一套 `simul_efun` 组成），但注册流程有额外分支，不要假设两者的 `--send` 序列完全一致。
xkm.english_description: Shares a code lineage (the same set of simul_efuns) with this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream), though its registration flow branches differently, so the two should not be assumed to share an identical connection sequence. It also shares the same "Xiake Xing I" map skeleton (Taihu Ancient Tomb, Kunlun, Shaolin, and more) with xkx2000zxb, making all three different circulating versions drawn from the same underlying codebase.
xkm.name: 侠客梦

xkx100.description: Coollizard & xkx100，2003-2004，yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100。这份档案与另外单独完成的 GitHub `fluffos/xkx100` 仓库是完全不同的代码库，只是恰好同名。
xkx100.english_description: By Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004, hosted at yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100 — a completely different codebase from the separately built GitHub fluffos/xkx100 repository that merely happens to share the same name. Its map is among the largest of its kind, stretching from central-China cities like Chang'an, Luoyang, Dali, and Xiangyang out to frontier and overseas settings such as the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, and Taiwan, covering nearly the full geography of ancient China. Character creation is unusually detailed for the genre, letting players choose a birthplace from five options, freely allocate attribute points, and pick from a menu of personality traits.
xkx100.name: 侠客行一百 (xkx100)

xkx2000zxb.description: 侠客行Ⅰ（"The Quest of Oriental Chivalry"），XiaKeXing GamingGroup 1996-1999，MudOS v22b25 世系，由 sdong 移植。`jym`（金庸梦）共享同一套地图骨架（`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景内容相同，只是文件头"破解"署名不同：这份是"Cracked by Kafei"，`jym`/`xkm`都是"Cracked by Roath"），应是同一款底层代码库的不同流通版本。
xkx2000zxb.english_description: The Quest of Oriental Chivalry ("Xiake Xing I"), by the XiaKeXing Gaming Group, 1996-1999, MudOS v22b25 lineage, ported by sdong. Shares the same map skeleton as this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream) — scenes such as d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc are identical in content, differing only in the "cracker" credit header ("Cracked by Kafei" here versus "Cracked by Roath" for jym/xkm) — evidently different circulating copies of the same underlying codebase. Its map covers classic sect landmarks like Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Murong clan, and Zhongnan, plus geographic settings such as Dongting Lake, Lake Tai, Huangshan, and the Western Xia region; registration opens with a GB/BIG5 encoding choice, typical of these older cross-strait shared designs.
xkx2000zxb.name: 侠客行2000最新版 (xkx2000zxb)

xkx2001.description: 由 "XiaKeXing Gaming Group" 制作，登录画面自称 1996-2003 年出品。属于早期"ES II"引擎家族的一支——与本项目中的 `rzrmud`（大唐西游）、`bmxkx2001`、`xuanjianlu`（玄剑录）等同属一个更古老的技术谱系，但游戏世界内容各自独立。精确到发行版本层面：`d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc` 等场景文件头带"Cracked by Roath"署名，和`bmxkx2001`/`jym`/`xkm` 是同一批流通版本；`xuanjianlu` 则是"Cracked by Kafei"的另一批流通版本（与 `xkx2000zxb` 同批），两批之间文件头署名不同，但核心引擎同源。
xkx2001.english_description: Produced by the "XiaKeXing Gaming Group," with a login screen claiming a 1996-2003 pedigree. Part of an early branch of the ES II engine family, sharing a more distant common technical ancestry with this project's rzrmud (Great Tang Journey West), bmxkx2001, and xuanjianlu (Record of the Mysterious Sword), though each has an independent game world — at the release level, scene files such as d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc carry the "Cracked by Roath" header shared with bmxkx2001/jym/xkm, while xuanjianlu belongs to a separate "Cracked by Kafei" batch (shared with xkx2000zxb); the two batches differ in header credit but share the same core engine. Set on "Xiake Island," new characters wake on the island's beach and are greeted by the "Rewarding Envoy" Zhang San or the "Punishing Envoy" Li Si, who guide them to registration before they set out into the jianghu proper. The world covers classic Jin Yong sects — Shaolin, Wudang, Huashan, the Beggars' Sect, the Xiuzhong Sect, and more — with a full apprenticeship, inner-cultivation, quest, and clan system; new arrivals must first follow a welcoming NPC to the island's registry and complete `register <email>`, a vintage anti-multi-accounting mechanism from the era.
xkx2001.name: 侠客行 Ⅰ (The Quest of Oriental Chivalry)

xkx2017.description: 侠客行（"The Story of Hero"），MudOS v21 世系——和 110 `xkx100`、111 `xkx2000zxb` 是同一核心代码库家族（`combatd.lpc`/`quest.h` 的结构一眼就能看出来）。
xkx2017.english_description: The Story of Hero, MudOS v21 lineage — part of the same core codebase family as this project's xkx100 and xkx2000zxb, visible at a glance in the structure of combatd.lpc and quest.h. It shares that core codebase but with a noticeably more compact map: the major sects (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and more) are all present, but it lacks xkx100's frontier settings like the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, or Taiwan, reading more like a streamlined remake. Unlike its sibling xkx2000zxb, admin privileges here use the standard wizlist text-file mechanism with no site-IP lock, making it simpler to set up.
xkx2017.name: 侠客行2017 (xkx2017)

xkxc98sj.description: 「侠客新传」v0.1b，MudOS v22pre11，Xkxz MUD Wizard Group 2000-2001，由 jjgod 维护。名字里带"书剑"二字，但和 `sjecl`/`sje`/`sjplgfjxb`/`sjplii` 那批真正的"书剑"系列泥潭完全不同源，纯属命名巧合（"98书剑"应该是站点当年的版本代号）。血统上也和同样带"XKX"/"侠客"字样的`xkx100`/`xkx2017`（另一支"侠客行"泥潭）无关——`master.lpc` 逐字节确认属于 AGENTS.md §11 的「"hell" / Doing Lu」支系（ES II → XKX →hell），和 `zjdyaryl`/`zjdyzj`/`hell` 同源，详见 NOTES.md 的深度测试记录。
xkxc98sj.english_description: "New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman" v0.1b, MudOS v22pre11, by the Xkxz MUD Wizard Group, 2000-2001, maintained by jjgod. Despite carrying "Book and Sword" in its Chinese title, it shares no lineage with this project's actual Book and Sword series (sjecl/sje/sjplgfjxb/sjplii) — the resemblance is purely coincidental naming, likely a site version codename from that year. It is also unrelated to the other "XKX"/Xiake-titled MUDs (xkx100/xkx2017) despite the similar name; a byte-for-byte comparison of master.lpc instead places it in the "hell / Doing Lu" lineage (ES II to XKX to hell), sharing ancestry with zjdyaryl, zjdyzj, and hell. Its map notably includes a Miao borderlands region with Gu-sorcery culture and sect settings, a relatively uncommon backdrop among these archives.
xkxc98sj.english_name: New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman: '98 Edition
xkxc98sj.name: 侠客新传98书剑 (xkxc98sj)

xkxlb.archive: 侠客行老版(金庸群侠传）.rar
xkxlb.description: 从一个扩展名错误的 `.rar`（实际是带有 `../` 成员路径的 POSIX tar）提取。归档里还带着一份未被使用的 `adm/obj/master.lpc`，恰好和jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 那套框架字节相同——但实际启动用的是`/adm/single/master`，不是这份。
xkxlb.english_description: Extracted from a mislabeled ".rar" that is actually a POSIX tar archive with "../"-prefixed member paths. The archive also contains an unused adm/obj/master.lpc that happens to share identical bytes with the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework code, but the site actually boots from a different file, /adm/single/master, so this look-alike master was never really loaded. Its map resembles the jyqxc/jyqxc2 family (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, and more).
xkxlb.english_name: Ode to Gallantry (Old Edition / Heroes of Jin Yong)
xkxlb.name: 侠客行（老版/金庸群侠传）

xkxyb.description: 厦门热线一百分支，MudOS V22pre11。这份档案和 110 `xkx100` 标题相同（都叫"侠客行一百"），但内容是真正不同的、更小的一份快照（6456 对 14255 个 `.lpc` 文件，目录结构也不一样，有 `ftp`/`mudos.etc`/`www` 这些 `xkx100` 没有的目录），不是重复压缩包，所以没有标记 `duplicate_of`。
xkxyb.english_description: A branch from the "Xiamen Hotline 100" site, MudOS V22pre11. Despite sharing a title with this project's xkx100 (also "Ode to Gallantry 100"), this is a genuinely different, smaller snapshot (6,456 vs. 14,255 .lpc files, with a different directory layout including ftp/mudos.etc/www directories absent from xkx100), not a duplicate archive. Its map and sect roster lean closer to a "standard" configuration — Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and the cities around Chang'an — more compact than xkx100's sprawling cross-border map. Comments in its bundled HTTP daemon note it was "modified to the ES2 mudlib base by xiaobao@XAJH," and another file marks its version as "MudOS v22.1b20, XAJH mudlib 2.0b," pointing to an earlier codebase branch known as "XAJH mudlib" rather than a direct descendant of xkx100's core code.
xkxyb.name: 侠客行一百 (xkxyb)

xkxz2.description: 由"Xkxz MUD Wizard Group"团队开发的武侠 mudlib，config 文件里残留着一个"海洋II上海总站"的字段，说明这份代码大概率是从"海洋II"的引擎基础上二次开发而来，但实际游戏内容与登录横幅都是独立的"侠客新传"。
xkxz2.english_description: A wuxia mudlib developed by the "Xkxz MUD Wizard Group." A leftover "Ocean II Shanghai Main Site" field in its config file suggests the code was likely built as a second-generation development on top of the "Ocean II" engine, though the actual game content and login banner present it as an independent title. The game opens at a "Peach Blossom Spring" paradise-like starting scene and blends character archetypes (Warrior, Wisdom, Endurance, Agility, Balanced) with sect martial arts for its wuxia progression system. Distinctively, a new character does not immediately "reincarnate" after basic registration — players must find the NPC Shuisheng in-game and complete `register <email>` before choosing their aptitude and gaining full stats, an intentional onboarding design rather than a bug.
xkxz2.english_name: New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman
xkxz2.name: 侠客新传 (New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman)

xkyx3b.description: 属于早期国产 MudOS 自研引擎，`adm/obj` 目录结构的小型武侠 MUD，没有明确的"系列血统"可归类——是一个独立开发的小型作品。
xkyx3b.english_description: A small, independently built wuxia MUD running on an early home-grown domestic MudOS engine (with the classic adm/obj directory layout). It doesn't belong to any larger game lineage in this archive — a standalone, compact creation with its own codebase.
xkyx3b.english_name: Legend of the Chivalrous Hero III
xkyx3b.name: 侠客英雄传 III

xkyxciii.description: 侠客英雄传 II/III「欢乐天地」，五邑无尽豪情，一个融合金庸小说、欧洲中世纪传说和漫画元素的世界观。
xkyxciii.english_description: Legend of the Chivalrous Hero II/III, subtitled "Happy Land" and also styled "Wuyi: Boundless Heroism," set in a world blending Jin Yong's wuxia novels with European medieval legend and comic-book elements.
xkyxciii.english_name: Legend of the Chivalrous Hero II/III (Happy Land)
xkyxciii.name: 侠客英雄传III (xkyxciii)

xlqy_early.description: 属于 ES II 引擎家族，与同批的"新仙侣情缘之飘渺纪元"（xlqy_new2007）同宗同源，是同一套代码更早、更粗糙的一个开发快照。根据这份存档自带的说明文件，它原本就是作者用来测试驱动兼容性的"半成品"版本。
xlqy_early.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family and the same lineage as its sibling archive "New Immortal Companions' Bond: Age of Mist" (xlqy_new2007) — an earlier, rougher development snapshot of the same codebase. According to notes included in the archive itself, it was originally a half-finished build the author used to test driver compatibility.
xlqy_early.name: 仙侣情缘（早期测试版）

xlqy_new2007.description: 属于 ES II 引擎家族，与"仙侣情缘（早期测试版）"（xlqy_early）系出同门，是这套仙侣情缘代码更完整、更成熟的一个版本（子标题"乱世站"）。
xlqy_new2007.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family and the same lineage as "Immortal Companions' Bond (Early Test Build)" (xlqy_early) — a more complete and mature version of the same codebase, subtitled "Station of Chaos."
xlqy_new2007.english_name: New Immortal Companions' Bond: Age of Mist
xlqy_new2007.name: 新仙侣情缘之飘渺纪元

xlqyzdb.description: 由 bugbug 与 alading 在"缥缈水云间"站点基础上二次开发。属于"仙侣情缘/XLQY"引擎家族的一个独立分支（与本项目另收录的《仙侣情缘》知秋站2001版代码不同，虽然核心引擎同源）。
xlqyzdb.english_description: Developed by bugbug and alading as a second-generation build on top of the "Misty Waters" server. An independent branch within the Immortal Companions' Bond (XLQY) engine family — distinct from this archive's other Immortal Companions' Bond codebase (the 2001 Zhiqiu-station version), though they share the same core engine.
xlqyzdb.english_name: Immortal Companions' Bond: Zhejiang University Edition
xlqyzdb.name: 仙侣情缘·浙大版

xo.description: 属于 TMI-2/ES2（Falcon 系）引擎家族，是"笑傲江湖"系列里体积最小、内容最精简的一个版本（作者称之为"mini xo"），与同批的"笑傲江湖最终版"（xo_final）同宗，后者正是在这个迷你版基础上扩充而成。
xo.english_description: Part of the TMI-2/ES2 ("Falcon") engine family, and the smallest, most minimal build in the Smiling, Proud Wanderer series — the author's own "mini xo." Its sibling archive, the Final Edition (xo_final), was expanded directly from this mini version.
xo.name: 笑傲江湖（迷你版）

xo_final.description: 属于 TMI-2/ES2（Falcon 系）引擎家族，是在"笑傲江湖迷你版"（xo）基础上大幅扩充开发而成的完整版本，作者自称"自玩测试站"，内容体量是迷你版的数倍。
xo_final.english_description: Part of the TMI-2/ES2 ("Falcon") engine family, greatly expanded from the Mini Edition (xo). The author describes it as their own private test server, with several times the content of the mini build.
xo_final.name: 笑傲江湖（最终版）

xsfyssjb.description: 风云Ⅳ（Sumxin 风云），以古龙小说为背景的 MUD（sumxin.com/bbs、fy.sumxin.com）。和这一轮的另一个"风云"手足档案`wqfy` 是同类 bug 模式，不过底层代码库并不相同；和 `fysjmb`（风云四解密版）才是真正同源代码——`d/dreamland/shanding.lpc` 等文件逐字节相同，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。
xsfyssjb.english_description: Wind and Cloud IV ("Fengyun," by Sumxin), a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's wuxia novels, originally hosted at sumxin.com/bbs and fy.sumxin.com. It is a true source sibling of this archive's "Fengyun IV Decrypted Edition" (fysjmb) — several core files are byte-for-byte identical — a relationship not previously documented, though it happens to share a similar bug pattern with the unrelated codebase behind this collection's "wqfy."
xsfyssjb.english_name: Voice of the Heart: Wind and Cloud IV, Upgraded Edition
xsfyssjb.name: 心声风云四升级版 (xsfyssjb)

xuanjianlu.description: 属于 ES II / 侠客行（XKX）引擎家族，与"侠客行 2001"等游戏同源，但拥有自己独立的武林世界与剧情内容，核心舞台设定在明教、昆仑、侠客岛等门派与地点之间。文件头带"Cracked by Kafei"署名，和 `xkx2000zxb` 是同一批流通版本（`xkx2001` 本身则是"Cracked by Roath"的另一批）。
xuanjianlu.english_description: Part of the ES II / Xiake Xing ("Wandering Blade") engine family, sharing lineage with titles such as "Xiake Xing 2001," but with its own independent wuxia world and storyline centered on sects and locations including the Ming Cult, Kunlun, and Xiake Island. Its files carry a "Cracked by Kafei" header, placing it in the same release batch as xkx2000zxb (a separate archive, xkx2001, circulated under a different "Cracked by Roath" release).
xuanjianlu.name: 玄剑录

xxcq.description: 小雪初晴，游戏内品牌为"SnowMud"，以温瑞安小说为背景，CuteRabbitStudio（JackyBoy）为 CCTX & SDXL 开发。
xxcq.english_description: Branded in-game as "SnowMud," set in the world of Wen Ruian's wuxia novels. Developed by CuteRabbit Studio (JackyBoy) for the CCTX and SDXL communities.
xxcq.name: 小雪初晴 (xxcq)

xxcqii.description: 小雪初晴II（SnowMud），以温瑞安小说为背景，117 `xxcq`（"大侠传奇之小雪初晴"）的姊妹档案。
xxcqii.english_description: The sequel to "First Snow Clearing" (SnowMud), also set in the world of Wen Ruian's wuxia novels. A sibling archive to this collection's xxcq ("Legend of the Great Hero: First Snow Clearing").
xxcqii.name: 小雪初晴II (xxcqii)

xyj2000.description: 西游记（"Journey to the West"，又名"西游记之新纪元"），以吴承恩原著为背景的一套老牌 MudOS mudlib，注册流程带有"不欢迎中小学生玩家"的年龄声明问答，属于原始设计的一部分，不是 bug。
xyj2000.english_description: Journey to the West, also known as "Journey to the West: New Era," a venerable old-school MudOS mudlib set in the world of Wu Cheng'en's classic novel. Its registration flow includes an age-declaration prompt stating it "does not welcome primary/secondary school players" — an original design choice, not a bug.
xyj2000.name: 西游记2000 (xyj2000)

xyj2000f.description: **西游记之新纪元**（xiyouji.org，1996-2000 年代的经典老牌 MUD）。属于**东方故事(ES) / 西游记引擎家族**，与本项目其他"西游记"系列同源。
xyj2000f.english_description: Journey to the West: New Era (xiyouji.org), a classic old-school MUD from the late 1990s. Part of the Eastern Tale (ES) / Journey to the West engine family, sharing lineage with this project's other "Journey to the West" titles.
xyj2000f.english_name: Journey to the West: New Era
xyj2000f.name: 西游记 2000 — xyj2000f

xyj20032.description: 档案名叫"西游记2003-2"，但游戏本身开机后自报家门是**三界神话（SanJieMyth）「测试二区」**——和 059 `sjcs`、060 `sanjieshenhua`是同一套"三界"代码库家族的另一个成员（`get_gender()`/`enter_world()`/`make_body()` 等核心函式和 `sanjieshenhua` 逐字比对完全一致），开机横幅还留着一段"西游记之新纪元"的 ASCII 字画，应该是更早一次改名留下的痕迹。
xyj20032.english_description: Archived under the name "Journey to the West 2003-2," but the game itself identifies at login as "Three Realms Myth," Test Zone 2 — the same codebase family as this archive's sjcs and sanjieshenhua (core functions such as get_gender(), enter_world(), and make_body() are byte-for-byte identical to sanjieshenhua). Its boot banner still carries leftover ASCII art from "Journey to the West: New Era," apparently a remnant of an earlier rebrand.
xyj20032.name: 西游记2003-2 (xyj20032)

xyj2006n.description: AKAI Studio 的 Tomud 品牌版西游记，和 xyj 系列/ES II 家族同宗，和`dtxywzxzb`（大唐西游完整修正版）地图逐字节相同（`d/gao/gate.lpc`等场景内容完全一致），应是同一套底层代码库的不同发行版本，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系；`xyj2006zzzhx`（西游记2006之最终幻想）也是同一批发行版本的手足档案。**连线后第一行不是常见的 GB/BIG5 选择，而是一个裸的 `version ` 提示**，期待客户端回传字面值 `2060`（Tomud 或"笑傲江湖"客户端的自动应答）；任何其他内容都会被识别为"非法客户端"并立即断线——这是刻意设计的客户端识别机制，不是 bug，测试时第一行务必送 `2060`。
xyj2006n.english_description: AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded release of Journey to the West, part of the Journey to the West series / ES II engine family. Its map is byte-identical to this archive's "Grand Tang Journey to the West: Complete Fixed Edition" (dtxywzxzb) — scene files such as d/gao/gate.lpc match exactly — suggesting both are different releases of the same underlying codebase, a relationship neither archive had previously documented. Its sibling release, "Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy" (xyj2006zzzhx), comes from the same distribution batch. Note for players: on connecting, the first line is not the usual charset-selection prompt but a bare "version" prompt expecting the literal client reply "2060" (an automatic response from Tomud/Smiling Proud Wanderer clients) — an intentional client-detection gate, not a bug.
xyj2006n.english_name: Journey to the West 2006 (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
xyj2006n.name: 西游记2006年 (xyj2006n)

xyj2006zzzhx.description: AKAI Studio 的 Tomud 品牌版西游记的另一个分支——和 122 `xyj2006n`是同宗档案（文件结构和 bug 完全一致），连线握手方式也一样：**第一行必须是裸的 `2060`**（Tomud/"笑傲江湖"客户端的自动应答），任何其他内容都会被判定为非法客户端并断线。
xyj2006zzzhx.english_description: Another branch of AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded Journey to the West line, sibling to this archive's xyj2006n (identical file structure and bugs). It uses the same connection handshake: the very first line sent must be the bare literal "2060" (the automatic reply from Tomud/Smiling Proud Wanderer clients), or the connection is treated as an illegal client and dropped.
xyj2006zzzhx.english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
xyj2006zzzhx.name: 西游记2006之最终幻想 (xyj2006zzzhx)

xyj42.description: 以西游记世界观为背景的 MUD。（`西游记4.2.rar` 是本归档纯换行符差异的重复版本，只处理了一次。）
xyj42.english_description: A MUD set in the world of Journey to the West.
xyj42.name: 西游记 4.2

xyj451.description: 西游记（ES II mudlib 家族，4.50 版）。注册流程**没有**"new"关键字：只要输入的英文 ID 还没有存档，就会直接问"使用 X 这个名字将会创造一个新的人物，您确定吗(y/n)？"。天赋点数不是选栏位调整，而是不断重掷的循环："您同意这组天赋数值吗？[n|y|q]"——`n` 重掷、`y`接受、`q` 大概是放弃。
xyj451.english_description: Journey to the West, part of the ES II mudlib family (version 4.50). Its registration flow has no explicit "new character" keyword — entering an English ID that isn't already on file goes straight to "Creating a new character named X — are you sure? (y/n)". Talent points aren't allocated by adjusting slots but through a reroll loop: "Do you accept these talent values? [n|y|q]" — n rerolls, y accepts, and q presumably abandons character creation.
xyj451.name: 西游记451 (xyj451)

xysylmhb.description: 《夕阳再现III 之 炎龙封印》，AKAI Studio 出品。和 xyj2006 系列一样用 Tomud/"笑傲江湖"客户端握手协议：**连线后第一行是裸的 `version `提示**，期待字面回传 `2060`。注册没有"new"关键字，任何还没存档的英文 ID 直接问"使用 X 这个名字将会创造一个新的人物，您确定吗(y/n)？"；天赋是菜单选栏位（`1-4` 指定单项数值，`0` 系统随机整组，然后 `y/n` 确认接受）。地图和"天涯"家族（`tybxjh`/`wlhd`/`xhcii`/`zxty`/`ffxymud`/`jhfy2`）逐字节相同（`d/city/sj.lpc` 的"世界之巅"跳崖场景一致），是这批档案里第七个确认的成员——虽然打的是"夕阳再现"品牌，实际地图和"天涯"同源，和真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`xajh4gkb`/`jhfy3`）反而没有关系，纯属品牌命名巧合。另外，`xyzx3`（夕阳再现III之炎龙封印）和这份档案几乎完全一致（`.lpc` 文件总数、目录结构、`d/city/sj.lpc` 都相同），很可能是同一个原始压缩包被本项目拆分成了两份独立档案。
xysylmhb.english_description: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio, uses the old Tomud/"Laughing in the Wind" client handshake protocol, where the first line after connecting must be answered with the literal code 2060. Despite its "Sunset Reappears" branding, its map data is byte-for-byte identical to the unrelated "Tianya" (Edge of Heaven) family of games rather than to the true Sunset Reappears lineage, one of several archives in this collection where the title brand and the actual code lineage don't match.
xysylmhb.english_name: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon (Fire Dragon Edition)
xysylmhb.name: 夕阳三-炎龙美化版 (xysylmhb)

xyxy2.description: 原始压缩包名为"20150716未知lib.zip"（来源不明），实际是**西游记题材、"泥潭"（nitan）系 MudOS 老牌 mudlib** 家族的一支，与本项目中的xiaoyuxiyou（同名系列的另一个快照）同源。
xyxy2.english_description: Originally archived under the generic filename "20150716 unknown lib.zip," this is actually a Journey to the West-themed entry in the venerable "Nitan" family of MudOS mudlibs, sharing a common lineage with this project's sibling snapshot xiaoyuxiyou. Set against the mythology of Journey to the West, it follows players through sects, magic treasures, and demons encountered along the pilgrimage route, with experience-point and potential-stat progression typical of the genre. New characters start out in worldly scenes like Chang'an's Yingxiong Restaurant, where they can take on a master, befriend fellow wanderers, and venture into demon-haunted realms; the overall tone is light-hearted and family-friendly.
xyxy2.english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West II (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)
xyxy2.name: 小雨西游Ⅱ (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)

xyxyutf8.description: 《小雨西游》/《小雨西游Ⅱ》引擎的另一份独立压缩包，档案名带"utf8" 暗示已经预先转成 UTF-8。和本项目已有的 003`xyxy2`（20150716未知lib）、003-1 `xiaoyuxiyou`（小雨西游）同属一个引擎家族，但经过内容哈希比对**不是**字节级重复（8753 对 11149 个 `.lpc` 档案，是不同时间点的快照，不只是重新编码而已），所以独立完整处理。
xyxyutf8.english_description: Another independent archive of the Xiaoyu Xiyou / Xiaoyu Xiyou II engine, its filename flagging that it had already been pre-converted to UTF-8. Though it shares an engine family with this project's xyxy2 and xiaoyuxiyou snapshots, a content-hash comparison shows it is not a byte-for-byte duplicate (8,753 vs. 11,149 .lpc files) — it's a snapshot from a different point in time, not just a re-encoding, so it was processed as its own distinct archive. Its map includes Aolai Country, the actual birthplace of Sun Wukong in the original novel, giving it geography closer to the source text than most other games in this family.
xyxyutf8.english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West (UTF-8 Snapshot)
xyxyutf8.name: 小雨西游utf8 (xyxyutf8)

xyzx.description: 《夕阳再现》之「风云再起Ⅱ」。`logind.lpc`/`master.lpc`/注册流程和`xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）/`xyzxiiylzymh`（夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端）非常相似，但这份档案的**地图**（`d/city/sj.lpc` 等）才是真正的"夕阳再现"血统——和 `jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb` 逐字节相同。反而是打着同样"夕阳再现"招牌的 `xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`，地图内容其实是完全不同的"天涯"家族（详见这两份档案的 README）——三者的关系和 `wlhd`/`tybxjh` 那种"核心系统档案同源、地图各自独立替换"的模式如出一辙。这份档案在**标准端口不需要** Tomud 客户端握手——`master.lpc` 的 `connect(port)` 只有连到专门的 TOMUD_PORT 才会设一个临时标记，`logind.lpc` 只有那个标记被设置时才会走 `2060` 版本检查，普通端口直接跳过。
xyzx.english_description: This is the "Storm Rises Again II" branch of Sunset Reappears. Its login and registration flow closely resembles sibling archives xysylmhb and xyzxiiylzymh, but its map data is the genuine Sunset Reappears lineage — byte-identical to jhfy3 and xajh4gkb — whereas those two similarly-branded siblings actually run on an unrelated "Tianya" map family, the same "shared core, swapped map" pattern seen elsewhere in this collection. Unlike its siblings, this build doesn't require the old Tomud client handshake on its standard port.
xyzx.english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
xyzx.name: 夕阳再现 (xyzx)

xyzx3.description: 游戏全名《夕阳再现III之炎龙封印》，2006 年由"阿凯工作室"（AKAI Studio）制作，登录后能看到的实际站点名叫"江湖风云"。这是国产 MudOS 老武侠Mud 里比较有代表性的一支，风格偏经典门派、内功修炼的江湖养成玩法。这份档案和另一轮处理过的 `xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）几乎完全一致（`.lpc` 文件总数、`d/` 目录结构、`d/city/sj.lpc` 内容都逐一核对相同），标题也几乎一样，很可能是同一个原始压缩包在本项目里被拆分成两份档案；地图本身其实是"天涯"家族血统，而不是真正的"夕阳再现"（详见`xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb` 的说明），品牌名称在这批档案里不能作为判断血统的依据。
xyzx3.english_description: The full title is "Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon," made in 2006 by AKAI Studio; the actual site name shown on login is "Jianghu Storm." It's a representative example of classic domestic MudOS wuxia MUDs, built around traditional sects and internal-power cultivation. This archive is nearly identical to the sibling archive xysylmhb — matching .lpc file counts, directory structure, and map content — and was likely split from the same original package into two separate archives here; its map actually belongs to the unrelated "Tianya" lineage rather than the true Sunset Reappears bloodline, a reminder that shared branding doesn't reliably indicate shared code in this batch of games.
xyzx3.english_name: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon
xyzx3.name: 夕阳再现III之炎龙封印

xyzxfk.description: 站点子名"疯狂江湖"。属于"夕阳再现"这一支武侠 MUD 引擎家族——与本项目中的 `xyzxfy2`（风云再起Ⅱ）、`wmkj`（未明空间）、`jhfy`（江湖风云单机）、`bixiecanyang`（碧血残阳）等同源，各自是不同站点在同一套引擎基础上发展出的独立游戏世界。这一支和另一轮处理过的 `xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同）——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
xyzxfk.english_description: The site's subtitle is "Crazy Jianghu." It belongs to the Sunset Reappears family of wuxia MUD engines, sharing common roots with this project's xyzxfy2 (Storm Rises Again II), wmkj, jhfy, and bixiecanyang — each an independent game world built by a different site on the same base engine. This branch carries the genuine Sunset Reappears map lineage (byte-identical to xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412), unlike another cluster of archives in this collection that share the same branding but actually run on an unrelated "Tianya" map family.
xyzxfk.name: 夕阳再现·疯狂江湖

xyzxfy2.description: 站点子名"风云再起Ⅱ"（域名 www.zhaoshu.net）。与本项目中的`xyzxfk`（疯狂江湖）同属"夕阳再现"这一支武侠 MUD 引擎家族——两者共享部分底层文件，但登录、安全、世界内容各自独立开发，是两个不同站点在同一基础引擎上分别发展出的游戏。这一支和另一轮处理过的 `xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412` 是同一个真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同）——注意本项目里还有另一批同样打着"夕阳再现"招牌、地图却是完全不同的"天涯"家族的档案（`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3` 等），品牌名称不能作为判断血统的依据。
xyzxfy2.english_description: The site's subtitle is "Storm Rises Again II" (domain www.zhaoshu.net). It belongs to the same Sunset Reappears family of wuxia MUD engines as this project's xyzxfk (Crazy Jianghu) — the two share some underlying files, but their login, security, and world content were developed independently as two separate games built on a common engine. This branch carries the genuine Sunset Reappears map lineage (byte-identical to xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412), unlike another cluster of similarly-branded archives in this collection whose maps actually belong to an unrelated "Tianya" family.
xyzxfy2.english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
xyzxfy2.name: 夕阳再现·风云再起Ⅱ

xyzxiiylzymh.archive: 夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端.rar
xyzxiiylzymh.description: 《夕阳再现III 之 炎龙封印》，AKAI Studio 出品，`xysylmhb`（夕阳三-炎龙美化版）家族的另一个版本，一样用 Tomud 客户端握手协议（连线后第一行是裸的 `version ` 提示，期待字面回传 `2060`）。和 `xysylmhb`一样，地图其实是"天涯"家族血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同），是这批档案里第八个确认的成员，标题品牌和实际代码血统再次对不上。
xyzxiiylzymh.english_description: Another build of Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon by AKAI Studio, in the same family as xysylmhb (Sunset III: Fire Dragon Edition), and likewise using the old Tomud client handshake protocol. As with xysylmhb, its map actually belongs to the unrelated "Tianya" family rather than the true Sunset Reappears lineage — another case in this collection where the title's branding doesn't match the underlying code's true origin.
xyzxiiylzymh.english_name: Sunset Reappears II: Fire Dragon Client Edition
xyzxiiylzymh.name: 夕阳再现II-炎龙专用美化客户端 (xyzxiiylzymh)

xyzxyl201412.description: 《夕阳再现》家族里改动更大的一个后期版本：自定义巫师阶层一路到`(boss)`/`(ceo)`，天赋分配之后多了一步十一系魔法天赋选择，还支持多端口（ZMud/ToMud）连接。
xyzxyl201412.english_description: A more heavily modified, later-stage build within the Sunset Reappears family: its custom wizard rank ladder runs all the way up to "(boss)"/"(ceo)", character creation adds an extra step for choosing one of eleven schools of magic after stat allocation, and it supports multiple client protocols (ZMud/ToMud).
xyzxyl201412.english_name: Sunset Reappears: Fire Dragon Edition (2014-12-31 Build)
xyzxyl201412.name: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231 (xyzxyl201412)

xzyx.description: 本游戏全名《乱世风沙之星战英雄》，属于早期国产 MudOS（xkx 系）派生的武侠 Mud。虽然名字听起来像科幻题材，实际是一款以江湖门派、内功外功为核心玩法的传统武侠 Mud，"星战"只是原作者取的一个响亮站名，与太空战争无关。
xzyx.english_description: The game's full title is "Sands of a Turbulent World: Star War Hero," an early domestic MudOS title in the "xkx" lineage. Despite the sci-fi-sounding name, it's actually a traditional wuxia MUD built around jianghu sects and internal/external martial cultivation — "Star War" was simply a catchy name chosen by the original author, with no connection to space warfare.
xzyx.name: 星战英雄

yanhuangwuhun.description: 属于 ES II 引擎家族（2003 年"炎黄"分支），与同批的"炎黄英雄史"系出同门，都源自同一套 2003 年由"lxtx"改写的引擎版本。
yanhuangwuhun.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family (the 2003 "Yan-Huang" branch), and a close sibling to this collection's "Chronicle of Yan-Huang Heroes" — both trace back to the same 2003 engine rewrite by developer "lxtx."
yanhuangwuhun.english_name: Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang II
yanhuangwuhun.name: 「武林群侠传」之炎黄武魂Ⅱ

yhwhpublicfi.description: Doing 一脉的又一个分支（`master.lpc` 文件头注明"for ES II mudlib...updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh2003.3"），游戏内标题为《武林群侠传》之炎黄武魂。注册流程采用姓+名分开输入，管理密码/登陆密码双密码制，角色创建时以 5 选 1 的角色类型菜单（猛士/智慧/耐力/敏捷/均衡）取代天赋随机菜单，且没有电子邮箱这一步。
yhwhpublicfi.english_description: Another branch of the "Doing" engine lineage — the master.lpc file header traces its history explicitly: "for ES II mudlib... updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3." In-game the title reads "Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang." Registration splits surname and given name into separate prompts and requires both an admin password and a login password; character creation replaces the usual random-stat menu with a five-way archetype choice (Warrior/Sage/Endurance/Agility/Balanced) and skips the email step entirely.
yhwhpublicfi.english_name: Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang (Public Final, 2016-12-08 Build)
yhwhpublicfi.name: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08 (yhwhpublicfi)

yhyxcs.description: 源自 2026-07-29 批量归档 `mudlib.rar` 中的 `银河英雄传说.zip`。ES II 引擎家族的一支（`master.c` 署名"原作 Lil，Annihilator 改写"），以田中芳树的科幻小说/动画《银河英雄传说》为背景重新设计。
yhyxcs.english_description: Sourced from a bulk mudlib archive collected on 2026-07-29. A branch of the ES II engine family (its master.c credits "original by Lil, rewritten by Annihilator"), redesigned around the setting of Yoshiki Tanaka's science-fiction novel and anime series Legend of the Galactic Heroes.
yhyxcs.name: 银河英雄传说

yhyxs.description: 属于 ES II 引擎家族（2003 年"炎黄"分支），与"炎黄武魂Ⅱ"是关系很近的姊妹作，共享同一套底层引擎，但拥有各自独立的剧情内容与世界细节。
yhyxs.english_description: Part of the ES II engine family (the 2003 "Yan-Huang" branch), and a close sibling to "Tales of Wulin Heroes: Soul of Yan-Huang II" — the two share the same underlying engine but each has its own independent storyline and world details.
yhyxs.name: 炎黄英雄史（游戏内也称"皇朝再现"）

ylfyxa3.archive: 炎龙封印-笑傲江湖3阿飞站.rar
ylfyxa3.description: 属于"夕阳再现"（XYZX/YLFY）引擎家族，游戏内登录横幅显示为「夕阳再现」之「笑傲江湖」，是由"阿飞"在"碎梦"修改的炎龙分支基础上再次深度改造而成的独立版本，与同引擎家族的其它"夕阳再现"系游戏是关系较远的表亲，而非同一份内容。
ylfyxa3.english_description: Belongs to the Sunset Reappears (XYZX/YLFY) engine family; its in-game login banner reads "Sunset Reappears: Laughing in the Wind." This build is a deep independent reworking by developer "Afei," built atop an earlier Fire Dragon branch modified by "Suimeng" — making it a distant cousin, rather than a direct copy, of the other Sunset Reappears games in this collection's engine family.
ylfyxa3.english_name: Seal of the Fire Dragon (Laughing in the Wind: Afei's Server)
ylfyxa3.name: 炎龙封印（笑傲江湖·阿飞站）

yszz.description: 一款以"西游记"神话世界为背景的武侠/仙侠向 MUD，新角色由西行取经的框架切入，起手在长安城"南城客栈"落脚。
yszz.english_description: A wuxia/xianxia MUD set in the mythological world of Journey to the West. New characters enter through the framework of the pilgrimage to the West, starting out at the South City Inn in Chang'an.
yszz.name: 妖神之争

yueyingqiyuan.description: 登录横幅原文亦作"世纪西游之月影奇缘"/"Moon Love Story"，一个以《西游记》世界观为背景改编的老牌 MUD。属于 ES II 引擎系列（与 `es1_win`、`xkx2001`、`rzrmud`、`xo` 等同源，master 文件署名可追溯到 "Lil"→"Annihilator" 这一支）。
yueyingqiyuan.english_description: The login banner also reads "Century Journey to the West: Moon Love Story" — a venerable MUD adapted from the Journey to the West mythos. It belongs to the ES II engine series (sharing lineage with this project's es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, and xo, with the master file's authorship traceable back through developer "Lil" to "Annihilator").
yueyingqiyuan.name: 月影奇缘

yxcs.description: 登录横幅自称 "1.YXCS"/"浴血重生"。血统比较特殊：既有 ES II 引擎系列的痕迹（`chinesed.lpc` 等文件署名可追溯到 "ES"→"XKX" 一支），又混入了"Lonely"（"nitan/NT" 系列的作者）后期改写的部分模块，属于一个 ES 系底子上被二次深度魔改的分支，不是纯血统的任何一支。地图这一层可以更精确地定位：`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）和"天涯"家族逐字节相同（与 `xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh`/`yzxiiizylfy`/`xyzx3`/`tianxiawuxue` 这批同样打着别的招牌、实际却是"天涯"血统的档案一致），"Lonely"这条线索也和 `tianxiawuxue` 鸣谢名单里的同一位作者相呼应。
yxcs.english_description: The login banner identifies itself as "1.YXCS" / "Reborn in Blood." Its lineage is unusual: it carries traces of the ES II engine series (files like chinesed.lpc trace authorship back through the "ES"-to-"XKX" branch) mixed with modules later rewritten by "Lonely," the author behind the Nitan/NT series — making it a deeply modified hybrid rather than a pure descendant of any single lineage. Its map can be pinned down more precisely: the "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is byte-identical to the unrelated "Tianya" family shared by several other archives in this collection.
yxcs.name: 浴血重生

yxjh.description: 《浴血江湖3梦回江湖》，KMMUD.COM 出品，注册流程为英文 ID → 中文全名（一次输入，不分姓和名）→ 管理密码/登陆密码双密码制 → 天赋菜单（0 随机整组，y 接受）→ 电子邮件 → 性别。地图和"天涯"家族的`wlhd`（武林浩荡/金庸梦II）几乎完全一致——`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）逐字节相同，用的正是 `wlhd` 独立改写过的那个"jump"版本，而不是 `tybxjh` 那个原始的、没加引号的版本，说明这份档案是在 `wlhd` 基础上（或共同祖先）继续演化而来，此前没有任何档案互相记录过这层关系。
yxjh.english_description: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu, published by KMMUD.COM. Registration runs through an English ID, then a full Chinese name entered as a single string (no separate surname/given-name split), a dual-password system (admin password plus login password), a talent menu (0 for a random full set, y to accept), email, and gender. Its map and code closely track the 'Tianya' family's wlhd (Wulin Haodang / Jin Yong's Dream II) — its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to wlhd's independently rewritten version — suggesting this archive evolved from, or alongside, wlhd, a lineage relationship no earlier archive in this collection had documented.
yxjh.english_name: Blood-Soaked Jianghu III: Return to the Jianghu
yxjh.name: 浴血江湖 (yxjh)

yxsj.description: 《逸俠之世界》（Daniel's World），ES II 引擎家族，台灣出品（BBS140.127.179.161，聯絡信箱 leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw）。注册流程为英文 ID → 中文名字 → 密码 + 确认 → 电子邮件 → 性别。
yxsj.english_description: Daniel's World (逸俠之世界), part of the ES II engine family, produced in Taiwan (BBS 140.127.179.161; contact leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw). Registration runs through an English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, email, and gender.
yxsj.name: 逸俠世界 (yxsj)

yxxcii.description: 《游侠笑传II》。支持双编码客户端（连线后先选择 GB 或 BIG5，BIG5提示行在 GBK 视角下故意显示成乱码，这是刻意设计，不是转码 bug）。注册流程为编码选择 → 英文 ID → 中文名字 → 密码 + 确认 → 天赋（y 接受）→ 电子邮件 → 性别。
yxxcii.english_description: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II. Supports dual-encoding clients — after connecting, players choose GB or BIG5 encoding, and the BIG5 prompt line deliberately appears garbled when viewed under GBK, an intentional design touch rather than an encoding bug. Registration runs through encoding choice, English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, talent selection (y to accept), email, and gender.
yxxcii.english_name: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II
yxxcii.name: 游侠笑传II (yxxcii)

yxzsj.archive: 逸  俠  之  世  界.rar
yxzsj.description: 《逸俠之世界》（Daniel's World），ES II 引擎家族，台湾出品。和`libs/yxsj` 是近亲关系（同样的标题、同样的联络信箱daniel@tpts4.seed.net.tw、同样的 bug 特征、同样的档案结构），但不是完全相同的档案——即使去掉空白/CRLF 差异后内容仍有差别（比如`adm/daemons/combatd.lpc` 差了大约 80 行），这份档案的`securityd.lpc` 存档路径检查本来就是对的（`yxsj` 那份需要修），说明这是同一份代码库在不同时间点的另一个版本，不是重新打包的同一批档案。
yxzsj.english_description: Daniel's World, the same ES II-family game as this collection's yxsj but a distinct build from a different point in the codebase's history — same title, same Taiwan contact email, same bug fingerprints, and the same file structure, yet not a byte-identical repackaging (its combatd.lpc, for instance, differs by roughly 80 lines) — worth keeping as a separate entry rather than treating as a duplicate.
yxzsj.name: 逸俠之世界 (yxzsj)

yzxiiizylfy.description: 《夕阳再现III之炎龙封印》，阿凯工作室（AKAI Studio）2006 年出品。和这批档案里其他"夕阳再现"家族一样，采用 Tomud "2060" 客户端版本握手（`get_id()` 会拒绝任何不是字面字符串 "2060" 的第一次输入，显示"你的客户端非Tomud或者非笑傲江湖WWW客户端"，然后才进入`get_id1()` 真正询问英文 ID）。虽然标题也叫"夕阳再现"，地图却和`xysylmhb`/`xyzxiiylzymh` 一样其实是"天涯"家族血统（`d/city/sj.lpc` 逐字节相同），和真正的"夕阳再现"血统（`xyzx`/`jhfy3`/`xajh4gkb`/`xyzxyl201412`）没有关系，是这批档案里第十个确认的"天涯"家族成员。
yzxiiizylfy.english_description: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio in 2006. Like the other 'Sunset Reborn'-titled archives in this collection, it uses the Tomud '2060' client handshake, rejecting any first input that isn't literally the string '2060' before asking for an English ID. Despite the 'Sunset Reborn' title, its map actually belongs to the unrelated 'Tianya' lineage (its signature cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to xysylmhb/xyzxiiylzymh), not the true 'Sunset Reborn' family (xyzx/jhfy3/xajh4gkb/xyzxyl201412) — the tenth confirmed 'Tianya' family member found in this collection.
yzxiiizylfy.english_name: Sunset Reborn III: Seal of the Flame Dragon
yzxiiizylfy.name: 夕阳再现III之炎龙封印 (yzxiiizylfy)

zhonghua2.description: 登录横幅完整标题为《中华英雄II武侠世界》，本压缩包是其中"苏州站"这一具体服务器实例，2006 年 3 月 1 日开站。核心引擎属于 ES II 引擎系列的衍生分支（master 文件署名一路可追溯 "Lil" → "Annihilator" → "Xiang forXKX" → "Doing Lu for hell"，最后由 "Linux@lxtx" 改写为本作），与本项目其它多个"终极地狱"/"轩辕"系列同属一个大家族，但内容和玩法已经改动很多，是相对独立的一支。
zhonghua2.english_description: The full login banner reads 'China Hero II: Wuxia World' — this archive is the 'Suzhou Station' server instance, which opened on March 1, 2006. Its core engine is a derivative branch of the ES II engine family (the master file's authorship trail runs from 'Lil' through 'Annihilator' and 'Xiang for XKX' to 'Doing Lu for hell', before being rewritten by 'Linux@lxtx'). It shares a distant common ancestor with this collection's other 'Ultimate Hell'/'Xuanyuan Legend' titles, but its content and gameplay have diverged into a relatively independent branch.
zhonghua2.name: 中华英雄苏州站

zhongjidiyu.description: MUD 内部标识为 `hell.local`，属于 ES II 引擎系列，与 `es1_win`/`xkx2001`/`rzrmud` 等同属一支，master 文件署名一路写明 "for ES IImudlib" → "Annihilator" → "Xiang for XKX" → "Doing Lu for hell"。需要特别说明：本项目里还有另外两个名字里也带"终极地狱"字样的压缩包（`zjdyaryl`、`zjdyzj`），那两个是"地狱"分支下的另一条独立血脉，与本作不是同一款游戏，只是碰巧都叫"终极地狱"，三者内容互不相同。
zhongjidiyu.english_description: Internally identified as hell.local, part of the ES II engine family alongside es1_win/xkx2001/rzrmud in this collection, its master file's authorship trail running through 'for ES II mudlib' to 'Annihilator', 'Xiang for XKX', and 'Doing Lu for hell'. Two other archives in this collection also happen to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in their name (zjdyaryl and zjdyzj) — those belong to a separate branch of the 'Hell' lineage and are different games entirely, sharing only the coincidental title; all three have unrelated content.
zhongjidiyu.name: 终极地狱之轩辕传说

zitengzhan.description: 大唐西游之紫藤站（登录后横幅也作【紫藤西游】），属于 ES II 引擎系列（与 `es1_win`/`xkx2001`/`rzrmud` 等同源，master 文件署名同样能追溯到"for ES II mudlib, original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator"）。
zitengzhan.english_description: Great Tang Journey West — Purple Wisteria Station (its in-game banner reads 'Purple Wisteria Journey West'), part of the ES II engine family, sharing common ancestry with this collection's es1_win/xkx2001/rzrmud and likewise signed 'for ES II mudlib, original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator' in its master file.
zitengzhan.english_name: Great Tang Journey West: Purple Wisteria Station
zitengzhan.name: 紫藤站

zjdy2008wzb.description: 《终极地狱2008完整版》（REVIVE OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM1999.11.13，CDS 出品）。和本次会话已经处理过的 `hell` 档案是同一个 Doing 血统的家族，`master.lpc`/`logind.lpc`/`named.lpc`/`versiond.lpc` 的结构几乎逐行一致。注册流程为英文 ID → 中文姓氏 →中文名字 → 管理密码 + 确认 → 登陆密码 + 确认 → 角色类型菜单（1-5）→ 性别。这份档案的提示行有实时时钟，测试时用了`--idle 0.3`。
zjdy2008wzb.english_description: Ultimate Hell 2008: Complete Edition ('Revive of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic)', originally from 1999.11.13, produced by CDS). Part of the same 'Doing'-lineage 'Hell' family as this collection's hell archive — its master.lpc, logind.lpc, named.lpc, and versiond.lpc are structured almost line-for-line the same.
zjdy2008wzb.name: 终极地狱2008完整版 (zjdy2008wzb)

zjdyaryl.archive: 终极地狱之爱若幽兰1.166正式版.rar
zjdyaryl.description: 游戏登录后自报家门为"地狱泥潭---爱若幽兰"（压缩包标题为"终极地狱之爱若幽兰"）。属于 ES II → XKX → "地狱"（hell）分支引擎家族，与`zjdyzj`（指间MUD版）是同一套"地狱"引擎核心的姊妹版本（两者 master 文件内容完全一致），与另一个同样带"终极地狱"字样、但内容完全不同的 `zhongjidiyu` 压缩包不是同一款游戏，只是名字碰巧相似。
zjdyaryl.english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Hell's Quagmire — Ai Ruo You Lan' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyzj ('Fingertip MUD' edition), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core down to an identical master file. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.
zjdyaryl.english_name: Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan
zjdyaryl.name: 终极地狱之爱若幽兰

zjdywzb.description: 《终极地狱完整版》（游戏内横幅：EMPEROR OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD &MAGIC) FROM 2002.06.2）。和本次会话已经处理过的 `zjdy2008wzb` 是同一个 Doing 血统的家族，`master.lpc`/`logind.lpc`/`named.lpc` 结构几乎逐行一致（原始档案本身就叫 `hell`）。注册流程为英文 ID →确认(y/n) → 中文姓氏 → 中文名字 → 管理密码 + 确认 → 登陆密码 +确认 → 角色类型菜单（1-5）→ 性别。这份档案的提示行也有实时时钟，测试时用 `mudclient.py --idle 0.5`（不是 1.0——会和每秒一次的时钟刷新赛跑导致指令发不出去，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节）。**WASM 阶段"注册流程完整验证过"的结论具有误导性**：深度功能测试（§10.7）发现每一个新角色都会在人物创建的强制步骤上被永久卡死，详见下方"深度功能测试"一节。
zjdywzb.english_description: Ultimate Hell: Complete Edition (in-game banner: 'Emperor of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic), from 2002.06.2'). Part of the same 'Doing'-lineage 'Hell' family as this collection's zjdy2008wzb — its master.lpc, logind.lpc, and named.lpc are structured almost line-for-line the same (the original archive was itself named hell).
zjdywzb.name: 终极地狱完整版 (zjdywzb)

zjdyzj.archive: 终极地狱-指间mud版服务端.rar
zjdyzj.description: 游戏登录后自报家门为"地狱无门"（"No Escape From Hell"，压缩包标题为"终极地狱-指间mud版服务端"）。属于 ES II → XKX → "地狱"（hell）分支引擎家族，与 `zjdyaryl`（爱若幽兰）是同一套引擎核心的姊妹版本，本作在此基础上额外接入了一层"指间MUD"手机客户端专用协议。与另一个名字里也带"终极地狱"的 `zhongjidiyu` 压缩包不是同一款游戏。
zjdyzj.english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'No Escape From Hell' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell — Fingertip MUD Edition'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyaryl ('Ai Ruo You Lan'), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core with an added layer supporting the 'Fingertip MUD' mobile-client protocol. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.
zjdyzj.name: 终极地狱-指间MUD版

zjmudhell.description: 从一个嵌套压缩包中提取（`zjmud.7z` 内的 `指间mud服务器+手机版客户端.zip`，内部文件夹名为 `hell`）——核心系统档案（`master.lpc`/`logind.lpc`等，为了配合下面的自定义手机协议被大幅改写过）和 `hell`/`zjdywzb`不同，master-hash 也不同，但地图内容其实逐字节相同（`d/motianya/mtdating.lpc` 等场景验证过完全一致，整个 `d/` 目录列表也几乎一样，只少了一个 `kunlun`）——这是本项目里"核心系统改写、地图原样保留"这一模式的又一个例子，此前 `hell` 的 README 没有记录过这层关系。和 [shujian3](../shujian3/) 是同一个手机 App 协议、同一套自定义 `logind.lpc` 血统，但注册流程的严格程度不同（见下）。
zjmudhell.english_description: Extracted from a nested archive (zjmud.7z, containing a folder named 'hell'). Its core system files (master.lpc, logind.lpc, and others) were heavily rewritten to support a custom mobile-phone client protocol, but its map content is byte-for-byte identical to this collection's 'Hell'/Doing engine family (hell/zjdy2008wzb/zjdywzb) — the entire sect-and-city world was ported onto an independently developed mobile client engine rather than being a simple in-engine derivative. It shares the same mobile-app protocol and custom logind.lpc lineage as shujian3, though the two differ in how strictly they enforce their registration handshake.
zjmudhell.name: 指尖MUD

zsdsj.description: RWlib v1.0.1，台湾团队开发的生活模拟/城市经营类 MUD，与本项目其他武侠类 mudlib 完全不属于同一谱系，是一套独立自制的引擎。
zsdsj.english_description: RWlib v1.0.1, a life-simulation and city-management MUD developed by a Taiwanese team — an entirely independent, self-built engine unrelated to this collection's wuxia-themed mudlibs. Rather than combat and leveling, it centers on farming, fishing, animal husbandry, running factories, real-estate trading, stock speculation, and mahjong, backed by a full system of city mayors, taxation, and enterprises; new characters can settle in a city (currently just one, the 'Abandoned City') to build a livelihood there.
zsdsj.name: 重生的世界 (Revival World)

zxty.description: 《再现天涯》（游戏内横幅：梦回天涯）。和本次会话之前处理过的Doing 血统 `hell` 家族没有关系，但和 `tybxjh`/`wlhd`/`xhcii` 那个"天涯"家族是同源代码——`d/city/sj.lpc`（"世界之巅"跳崖场景）逐字节完全相同，此前处理这四份档案时都没有互相记录这层关系。档案里有一个巫师个人目录 `u/zjb/`，里面放了好几份核心系统文件的旧备份（`logind.lpc`、`master.lpc`、`securityd.lpc` 等）——用grep 确认过这些备份没有被任何活动路径引用（`include/globals.h`和 `config.fluffos` 里 `LOGIN_D`=`/adm/daemons/logind`、`MASTER_OB`=`/adm/obj/master`），所以本次只修了这两份真正生效的文件，`u/zjb/` 下的备份保持原样没动。
zxty.english_description: Tianya Reborn (in-game banner: 'Dream Return to Tianya'). Unrelated to the Doing-lineage 'Hell' family covered elsewhere in this collection, but shares the same source code as the 'Tianya' family (tybxjh/wlhd/xhcii) — its 'Peak of the World' cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to theirs, a lineage relationship none of those four archives had previously documented about each other.
zxty.name: 再现天涯 (zxty)

zxty08nxgbb.description: 与 138/zxty 同一款游戏（"再现天涯"）的 2008 年修改重发布版本，master.lpc 内容不同、无精确 hash 匹配，但同名同源。
zxty08nxgbb.english_description: The 2008 revised re-release of the same 'Tianya Reborn' game as this collection's zxty — the master.lpc content differs with no exact hash match, but it shares the same title and origin. Its quit command has a genuine anti-abuse mechanism: a new account logged in for under 30 minutes must press quit twice to actually exit without saving, a deliberate design choice rather than a bug.
zxty08nxgbb.name: 再现天涯（08年修改版本）

zzfy.description: 游戏登录后自报家门为"天下无敌"（压缩包标题"郑州风云3"是收藏者对这个具体服务器实例的称呼），属于风云（Fengyun）引擎系列，与本项目里的`fy2`/`fy2005`/`fengyun434`/`moniHuafu` 等同属一个大家族。
zzfy.english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Invincible Under Heaven' (the collector-assigned title 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' names this particular server instance). Part of the Fengyun ('Storm') engine family, alongside this collection's fy2/fy2005/fengyun434/moniHuafu. The game bills itself as 'a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels' — rather than the Jin Yong-flavored wuxia common elsewhere in this collection, it leans into Gu Long's brisk, devil-may-care style of jianghu storytelling. Character creation lets players choose an ethnicity (Han, Miao, Manchu, or Mongol), an unusual touch for this engine family.
zzfy.name: 郑州风云3

zzfy3.description: 《郑州风云3》（游戏内横幅：风云系列之天下无敌）。以古龙小说为背景的风云系列 MUD，由长孙无情（Xgchen）建立，和 `wqfy`（无情风云，同样打着"天下无敌"横幅）是同一套"郑州风云"地图与代码库——`d/marry/hongniang-zhang.lpc` 逐字节相同，此前两份档案都没有互相记录这层关系。档案里有一个巫师个人目录 `u/wiz/u/xxy/`，里面是真正的游戏内容（武功/NPC 档案，不是死代码备份），另外还有几份真正没用的 `logind.lpc` 备份放在`d/wiz/xgchen/`、`u/wiz/u/china/`、`u/wiz/u/lxh/` 下——用`include/globals.h` 里的 `LOGIN_D`=`/adm/daemons/logind` 和`MASTER_OB`=`/adm/obj/master` 确认过只有`adm/daemons/logind.lpc` 和 `adm/obj/master.lpc` 是真正生效的，那几份 `logind.lpc` 备份没有动，但 `u/wiz/u/xxy/` 下的`is_killing()` 呼叫点是真正会被玩家碰到的游戏内容，**修了**。
zzfy3.english_description: Zhengzhou Storm 3 (in-game banner: 'Fengyun Series: Invincible Under Heaven'), a Gu Long-style wuxia MUD founded by Xgchen ('Elder Sun Wuqing'). Shares the same 'Zhengzhou Storm' map and codebase as this collection's wqfy ('Heartless Storm', which carries the same 'Invincible Under Heaven' banner) — a relationship neither archive's documentation had previously noted. It also turns out to be a near-duplicate of this collection's other 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' archive (zzfy): same engine and map, over 10,000 files nearly all identical, differing in fewer than 200 — the two are kept as separate entries rather than merged.
zzfy3.name: 郑州风云3 (zzfy3)

zzhj.description: 「最终幻境」（The Final Frontier，简称 FF）是一个改写自「东方故事II」(ES2) 函数库的太空科幻题材 MUD，由 Spock 创立——是本项目 ES II/东方故事大家族里罕见的科幻换皮版本，而非武侠题材。存档原为繁体中文（BIG5）内容，已转换为 UTF-8。
zzhj.english_description: The Final Frontier (FF), a space-opera science-fiction MUD adapted from the 'Dongfang Gushi II' (Eastern Story II, ES2) codebase, founded by Spock — a rare sci-fi reskin within this collection's ES II/Eastern Story family, rather than the usual wuxia setting. Its save data was originally Traditional Chinese (BIG5) and has been converted to UTF-8.
zzhj.name: 最终幻境 (The Final Frontier)
